Fellow American,

I'm debating my Radical Left Opponent, Amy Klobuchar, tomorrow.

I CANNOT WAIT TO EXPOSE HER FOR WHAT SHE IS - A WHITE LIBERAL WOMAN WHO THINKS SHE'S BETTER THAN ALL OF US AND THINKS SHE KNOWS BEST!

The election is just DAYS away, and I need your help. Can you chip in any amount before midnight to help me get the resources I need to place TV ads and knock on the doors of undecided voters?

I know that I'm going to get a lot of great clips from this debate that I plan on turning into last-minute political ads before the election.

But, I am going to need CASH NOW so I can make the ads and air them across Minnesota.

**[Can you chip in before midnight to help me Flip the Senate?](https://links.iterable.com/u/click?_t=ce1ce9e616484205a28a45cfaf96cecf&_m=2ed23bd47e1744eb929ec4f1310b694c&_e=ooAkoL8vIA1GmXb1TiGjxY4H-ufmXnQg8pYCnE6kOYO15D2zKLswWte3WF4Qg2vLfCOSk5leVCoh_kiBdBxhbCHyJbmTF6TQKjUFtioO9fISOs19Rj7vffvpnrEKrUWFfCUdyiPwAYYfSN64Ud55FMXcIgR7a7DasPm1HinHxuUXr3x6i8qr_4oWb3UInuLtnQmwGCHrNR2iqlOUNWSH1cdHn0fmGV1aAFwdvjZSYXkwVI8uUIVZD91ZfSpsZ_SJf-xkR7Q9A1p2DwfiPxjLcZBfxPPi7sj-jKmDOwOOQjL-gBqufMm2M1xmGsN313sF-xxvSVM957pZn8MFAAAMrw%3D%3D)**

Godspeed,
Royce White

|

Meet Royce White:

**Born and raised in the Twin Cities, Royce White was the son of a single mother and started playing sports at the age of 5 years old. Living in various neighborhoods growing up, much of his family remained in the Rondo community, where he spent much of his time and received schooling. White excelled at basketball and recieved a scholarship to play basketball at the University of Minnesota, and later transferred to Iowa State. He would go on to make Dean's List while receiving All Big-12 first-team honors and many other basketball awards.

_After being selected 16th overall by The Houston Rockets in the NBA draft, White began to voice concerns about the NBA 's collective bargaining agreement (CBA), specifically regarding mental health policy, which at the time did not exist. Eventually, his concerns became a public dispute between White and the NBA. This resulted in White demanding that the NBA, as a representative of the global corporate community, take up the responsibility of spearheading the mental health conversation - not just posturing through press statements, but through policy._

Royce then went on to win two championships in Canada before moving over to play Big 3 Basketball. White appeared at a game in a t-shirt that read "Free The Uyghurs." After a game-winning basket, White did a post-game interview on CBS, where he called for 2 Million Uyghurs to be freed and released from concentration camps. As the season went on, White would touch on taboo topics such as Gain of Function Research, The Federal Reserve, Julian Assange, Edward Snowden, Larry Hoover, Jeff Fort, Muammar Gaddafi, The Great Reset, Ivermectin, Me Too, etc.

Now, Royce White is running for Senate in Minnesota to take down the Radical Left. Republicans have not seen recent success in Minnesota, but Royce's campaign is different: a grassroots movement that's sick of the Radical Agenda pushed by Far Left Democrats Amy Klobuchar and Ilhan Omar. Royce needs your help to pull off a fourth quarter comeback victory and FLIP Minnesota Red for Republicans.

** **PASS ROYCE AN ASSIST**

name: Patti Reilly
subject: My police officer son is going to prison for doing his job
body:
Dear Peter,

My son, Washington Metro Police Officer Terence Sutton, was just sentenced to 5 1⁄2 years in prison for doing the job he was trained to do.

And though you and I have never met, I'm praying you'll help me save him.

Here are some photos of Terence as a little boy.

[](http://links.conservativeum.com/u/click?_t=26c2e4aa9bbe40418f61e26972138f21&_m=58a382dfc0344e268fb8b090ea355907&_e=I073h1kxd4hCtwzGUYn3s34PF0M23I634hch8O03cxAqCcRpHuX1-htU_ibZkmruqsOfZrbLA0Pg-4p2fMPLEQQaxRL-FRu1CzhiJVVt3BaMYnTk-HVtjJSgm6P0dW6h1_piqfthYxF_IwuEX1MDV1Y14jBlipZ5Lk3E1atmOYgrTjn402WHbIIu2g6D8rXmARwE5KzGxengT3euv-nfEBOqZBqi0pAaW5P6RYUUTXl4rYMvrd1R2aomFRP40J2fGTHxmjOx4EmuTGcl1z9zU4UeuttPM5F1-hzn6xJ1AdprLAIqfmYJc-tGWl_AoxAn4LSHiKR2du86SYo80sotPZvpL8_up5bQkSfSEQOBMf_TH0pytMBhu5AIycWtZVlFyTswJWwl4d-ttAYLn5AeEGSoctY2RotLZkMTU36TF8MHIgMb2Pu3qQzvX7HyVsTn)
He always dreamed of following in his dad's footsteps to be a police officer. I also included one of my favorites of us from the night he graduated from the Police Academy.

I was so proud that night.

Never in my wildest imagination could I have predicted that my son would be _wrongfully_ _convicted_ _of_ _murder_ **- murder of a criminal my son didn't even touch.**

[**_I 'm praying you will help me save my son_**](http://links.conservativeum.com/u/click?_t=26c2e4aa9bbe40418f61e26972138f21&_m=58a382dfc0344e268fb8b090ea355907&_e=I073h1kxd4hCtwzGUYn3s34PF0M23I634hch8O03cxAqCcRpHuX1-htU_ibZkmruqsOfZrbLA0Pg-4p2fMPLEQQaxRL-FRu1CzhiJVVt3BaMYnTk-HVtjJSgm6P0dW6h1_piqfthYxF_IwuEX1MDV1Y14jBlipZ5Lk3E1atmOYgrTjn402WHbIIu2g6D8rXmARwE5KzGxengT3euv-nfEBOqZBqi0pAaW5P6RYUUTXl4rYMvrd1R2aomFRP40J2fGTHxmjOx4EmuTGcl1z9zU4UeuttPM5F1-hzn6xJ1AdpOYKZOpLsR115ArdZ1fEGQdJPYj4m2pX8C92vVubyEDT1HfbH9ZK5W0hRGjE3m8n9kt9D1L140ERMtiRrCPUbFMCDSad_k9fxdR_i1ePdcpTailXKI9wFvJ5QIEl8egN_LV_0MsIjZWmqTxg3cn5us) - **but first, let me explain what happened.** Our nightmare started in October of 2020.

Terence was sitting in his patrol car when he received a report that a known gang member, Karon Hylton-Brown, was seen entering a rival gang's territory.

Karon was a violent criminal with a rap sheet a mile long - including drugs, illegal gun possession, and assaults. Earlier that day, he was seen arguing with a rival gang member who owed him money. So Terence and other officers were concerned Karon was planning to get revenge.

When Terence saw Karon illegally driving a motorized scooter on the sidewalk without a helmet, he tried to pull him over to talk. Instead, Karon took off on the scooter.

Terence watched as Karon sped through traffic, weaving in and out of cars and blowing past red lights and stop signs.

My son knew Karon was putting others at risk, so for 3 minutes he slowly and carefully followed behind in his patrol car.

Then it happened.

subject: Israel has blocked U.S. and international journalists from Gaza for more than a year
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY JUSTICE DEMOCRATS
body:
[1]Justice Democrats

Peter,

Since Israel has prohibited U.S. and international journalists’ access to
Gaza for the past year, we’ve largely witnessed this genocide unfold
through cell phone videos and first-person testimony of Palestinians
forced to document their own destruction.

You may remember when the Israeli military claimed there was a Hamas
command center underneath a major hospital in Gaza, an excuse used to drop
bombs on this and every hospital in the area, destroying Palestinians’
entire healthcare infrastructure.

Israel is now attempting to use the same playbook in Lebanon, where it’s
claiming Hezbollah has an underground bunker underneath a major Beirut
hospital. There is no excuse that justifies bombing healthcare facilities.

This time around, Israel cannot ban international media outlets from
investigating on the ground, and multiple journalists have already
debunked these claims.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/signup/petition-20241024-media-access-gaza/?source=em20241026-36098&akid=36098%2E1203867%2EgPf2gH ]Saul Staniforth tweet: Israel claims Hezbollah is using a bunker under
a Beirut hospital so @alexrossiSKY went to have a look & talk to a doctor
there. He didn't find any evidence, because there isnt any. What Israel is
doing is creating a pretext for attacking the hospital. Just like they did
in Gaza

It’s beyond time for U.S. and international reporters to be granted
unfettered access to Gaza. The Palestinian people deserve transparency,
accountability, and freedom of the press, and the world must see the full
extent of Israel’s genocide and ethnic cleansing that our U.S. tax dollars
are funding.

A group of 64 House Democrats, including all Justice Democrats incumbents,
have signed a letter urging the Biden administration to demand Israel
grant unimpeded media access to Gaza.

| | Dear Friend,

Citizens are free to say what they think. Subjects aren't.

Sadly, the question of whether we are citizens or subjects has become politically controversial in our country. A clear sign of this is the attempt to suppress the expression of obvious truths, such as the fact that boys cannot become girls.

Another sign that many of our leaders consider us subjects is their denial of our right to decide who is allowed to enter our country--indeed, they tell us that if we complain about mass illegal immigration, we are racists.

**This is a pivotal time in our nation 's history--a time when we must stand up and forthrightly demand to be treated as citizens, not subjects. Because freedom hangs in the balance.**

A poisonous ideology has infected almost every major American institution. Only a few still stand in defense of freedom and the right of self-government.

One of the most important of these is **Hillsdale College**. And today, my friends at Hillsdale need your partnership and support in their mission to preserve the blessings of civil and religious liberty through education.

For 180 years, Hillsdale has offered its students the kind of education America's founders thought necessary to sustain free government. And in recent decades, Hillsdale has extended its teaching mission nationwide with a vast national outreach effort.

This outreach effort includes its free publication _Imprimis_ , its free online courses, and its tireless work to return excellence--including excellent civics instruction--to American K-12 education.

And Hillsdale College does all of this while refusing to accept one penny of government funding--not even indirectly through federal or state student grants and loans.

That's why I ask you to take the time to view their video **"[The Electoral College Explained](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=a02967268a8a4f2794c2dc3d4020c17e&_e=ffs10AeWDhRrnKKSFwNT3Yubl38kAKAp1PQKKrTZCIE5X6pHXM9D6oqPWm4f6ipg35q0UZ5leaZOyJnbhy5c8N5uSWuMATrwOA0zoko-TCP0YmFUuilAOxf5c52UTr2PZlJxmb4NkfnJyVOyX-At6pZ0zrv9uckgoRvuXmIyxsiMqG0862cITvLzIfV7yt-0kAN37oHKq6rxOruV8Tv2JsBDRqQLNYrs0d0srjY7H-bcctABZUtwlyMhVY7XOBHCkXhKD1n1AAEuCBwZCrEJK3qUMPxF-2MD7d0rd4ltGHi-oqriEd4rRGlvg4vX0_e47vaQV3FqdrTTP7wxR9RWgXJy4l_NLROtwEwpSTfBWyNQxY8OFxKKYZYLbziQSGengRhrvz9tSRlSepW1xANqVg%3D%3D)"** below and join Hillsdale in defending freedom and the American way of life.

Recent polls in Texas and Florida show incumbent Senators **Ted Cruz** and **Rick Scott** in neck-and-neck races against leftwing Democrat challengers with control of the Senate hanging in the balance. name: Josh Harder
subject: I just got out of an important meeting
body:
Here’s an update.

Peter,
I just left a meeting with my Campaign Manager Ryan, and I have to be honest... We’re not where we need to be.
We still have $50,000 left to raise before the end of the month, and we’ve got just 5 days to close that gap before our final end-of-month deadline. That’s no small feat... it’s a pretty scary position to be in this close to the election!

If you do not have an ID, you may be asked to fill out a provisional ballot. Questions about voting? Call our Pennsylvania voter hotline at 833-728-6837 | | Happy voting! Team Harris-Walz P.S. Already voted? then make sure your friends and family have plans to vote, too. | | | |

| | | | **folks, we believe in the promise of America.** Kamala Harris knows this promise intimately. She is the daughter of an immigrant mother from India who dedicated her life to curing breast cancer and an immigrant father from Jamaica who came here in search of a better education. Their shared commitment to civil rights brought them together, and Kamala absorbed these selfless duties from an early age. She made a promise to the people—a promise to remain **For The People**. Because if it weren’t for the unique, empowering promise of America, and the civil rights trailblazers who paved the way, Kamala Harris wouldn’t have been standing on that DNC stage, an empowered woman accepting her nomination for President of the United States of America! Tim Walz also understands the depths of America’s promise. He knows that in this country, your neighbors are your confidants, and no matter where you come from—whether rural America or the big cities—**YOU MATTER**. As a veteran who served for 24 years, a father made possible by IVF, the father of a neurodivergent son, a former teacher and coach, and above all, a devoted husband and father, Tim Walz gets us.

name: Jon Tester
subject: grounded
disclaimer_text: Paid for by VPP
body:
| Can I tell you a story about my family farm, folks? [](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/83568?t=6&akid=17789%2E878179%2EZkE7ie) In 1910, my grandfather came to Montana. He found a piece of grassy land, took a look at it, and said, “This is the place.” And that’s where the farm began.

He farmed the land until the early 1940s, and then passed it down to my folks. In 1978, my wife Sharla and I took over the farm and we’re still here today, three generations and more than 40 years later.

We’ve made a lot of progress here — Sharla and I built a new home, several steel buildings, and more storage.

The truth is, I love this work. Yes, it makes for early mornings and late nights during planting and harvest seasons — but it also keeps me grounded, and it gives me perspective on the issues we face every day.

When I think about climate change, I’m thinking of folks on farms like mine, struggling with catastrophic droughts or historic levels of flooding. When I think about reforming the USPS, I’m thinking of the people in rural communities across Montana who rely on timely mail delivery for their medication or Social Security checks. And when I think about infrastructure, I’m thinking of the rural towns near mine that need access to affordable, high-speed internet.

**These aren’t abstract issues or talking points. They’re very real challenges that deserve real solutions, and that’s what I’m fighting for in Washington. I spend every single day trying to do right by working families, farmers, students, and veterans here in Montana and across the country.

[I’m running for reelection because there’s still work to be done. Just like my parents and grandparents on the family farm, when I commit to something, I see it through. Can you make a split donation of any amount today between my campaign and Voter Protection Project to help me keep up the fight in Washington?](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/83568?t=7&akid=17789%2E878179%2EZkE7ie)** If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your split donation between Jon Tester and VPP will go through immediately: | [CONTRIBUTE $5 »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/83569?t=8&akid=17789%2E878179%2EZkE7ie)
---
[CONTRIBUTE $25 »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/83570?t=9&akid=17789%2E878179%2EZkE7ie)
[CONTRIBUTE $50 »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/83571?t=10&akid=17789%2E878179%2EZkE7ie)
[CONTRIBUTE $100 »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/83572?t=11&akid=17789%2E878179%2EZkE7ie)
[Or a custom donation »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/83573?t=12&akid=17789%2E878179%2EZkE7ie)
I’ll leave you with one last truth about farming: Some years you get the right amount of rain, and things work out really well. Other years, you get a whole lot less.

That means it’s important to be prepared for any outcome, and to have a support system by your side when things get difficult. We don’t know what this campaign will look like, or what Republicans will throw our way over these final weeks. But with your support, we’ll be ready.

I appreciate anything you’re able to pitch in. Thanks for your help, and I hope I make you proud.

— Jon

body:
That's the scoop, according to The Hill

| | |
---
|
---
Is Mitch McConnell secretly stabbing conservative senators in the back this November? That's the scoop, according to _The Hill: "**Cruz and Scott, both McConnell critics, get cold shoulder amid tough races."**_
---
|
---
---
|
---
Recent polls in Texas and Florida show incumbent Senators **Ted Cruz** and **Rick Scott** in neck-and-neck races against leftwing Democrat challengers with control of the Senate hanging in the balance. Yet, while McConnell’s money machine is pouring cash into some Senate races, it’s conspicuously ignoring these two key states. Everyone knows why. Ted Cruz and Rick Scott are conservative patriots, not leadership lapdogs. They fight for the American people and for the Constitution, which means they often challenge the Beltway Establishment. **[**Please don't sleep on these Senate races. Support Ted Cruz and Rick Scott with a split contribution today.**](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=c0f3bf080ec54310b6217f7a0d9e91d6&_e=FGwku4kmrWYSJdVg9m0PEFIuUr1WuHC8r-FH83saGF3skuVYpuzrlNxdt8CP6GGK2jxdvyNEG9bZ2kQ3auCsLZqWBgNYZIU1Jptg6w7LUvXm17-gf5IloPosLtJ0m57sOph4ysqjnzT3ry2cr1I6z8Meh8dTjHBPdwCGGBnvDwQ4Q6XZuvdUqSgYUtPSs3HXbNPIh3syoGB7Pf9Hgwi46KLST162wKUSglA84MkV3Q33l1Tv9deZsYSgSrC31hgn)** **_"Mitch McConnell runs the largest Republican super PAC in the country," said Senator Cruz. "It has $400 million, but that super PAC is used to reward the Republican Senators who obey him and to punish those who dare to stand up to him_."** So while Democrats pump millions into Texas and Florida to turn them blue, Washington Republicans are slow-walking their support — even as these races tighten. Please see a special message from our sponsor:

Dear Fellow American,

I'm reaching out to you today because I'd like to send you your 2025 Hillsdale College calendar.

I know, I know. It's a little early to be thinking about 2025. But since you're someone who cares about liberty, I wanted to make sure you had this chance to get the 2025 calendar.

Claim your 2025 Hillsdale College calendar before October 31 by clicking on this secure link:
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/ct/63668081:sQGF0MWBN:m:3:2532013465:4173AE98AC981FA268CB25EE6002084E:r

As you know, we live in an era of increasing bureaucratic despotism. You've seen it, and you understand. More and more, we are ruled by an administrative state that operates without the say of our elected representatives.

It is, therefore, completely unaccountable to "we the people."

This collapse of the separation of powers has spread far beyond the federal level into our states, our cities, and maybe even where you live!

One particularly disturbing example is in our K-12 schools…

At these schools, swarms of administrators impose dangerous ideologies and actively undermine parents.

In higher education-especially at taxpayer-funded state universities-bloated administrations push ideologies that teach young Americans to disrespect or even hate their country.

But thanks to our supporters, we remain free of this corrupting influence. We stay true to our mission…

…to provide "sound learning" that preserves "the blessings of civil and religious liberty."

Indeed, as the crisis in our nation has deepened in recent years, we have redoubled our efforts to extend this mission nationwide. But we've only been able to do so thanks to supporters like you.

Just in the last year, our dedicated supporters have helped to…

Teach 4 million Americans in Hillsdale's free online courses, including "Constitution 101: The Meaning and History of the Constitution," "The American Left: From Liberalism to Despotism," and our newest course, "Marxism,
Socialism, and Communism."

Distribute hundreds of thousands of free copies of the Constitution to citizens nationwide-especially younger Americans, especially thousands of K-12 students.

Provide an American classical education to young students nationwide through K-12 education programs, returning excellence and proper civics instruction to K-12 classrooms.

Expand the circulation of Imprimis, Hillsdale's monthly digest of liberty, to more than 6.7 million households and businesses.

I hope you'll claim your 2025 Hillsdale College calendar so that when you use it next year, you'll remember how you can advance the important work of defending liberty through education.

Remember, your support is especially crucial because we refuse every penny of government funding-even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants and loans. NOT. ONE. PENNY-to remain INDEPENDENT!

Your generosity, and that of tens of thousands of people like you, reaches and teaches millions of Americans nationwide. You'll help enroll millions more Americans in free online courses, expand the readership of Imprimis, and
restore excellence to K-12 education.

Please show your support today by making your best tax-deductible gift of $50, $75, or $150-or the best gift you can-by clicking the secure link below:
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/ct/63668081:sQGF0MWBN:m:3:2532013465:4173AE98AC981FA268CB25EE6002084E:r

And when you do, you'll claim your 2025 Hillsdale College calendar. But you must act before October 31.

Thank you for being a steadfast Hillsdale supporter. Your generosity is needed now more than ever.

Warm regards,

Bill Gray, '01
Vice President
Institutional Advancement
Hillsdale College

P.S. Claim your 2025 Hillsdale College calendar before October 31 at the secure link below:
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/ct/63668081:sQGF0MWBN:m:3:2532013465:4173AE98AC981FA268CB25EE6002084E:r

When you do, you will defend liberty and help us accomplish our mission year after year. Everything we accomplish is only possible due to your continued generosity, so thank you for your support of our mission!

Senator Reverend Raphael Warnock here.
Elections are about the character and future of our nation. They’re about the future we want for ourselves and for our children.
That’s why I’m asking you to join me in supporting Elissa Slotkin for Senate in Michigan.
Elissa Slotkin is the kind of leader you can believe in -- principled, tough, and focused on getting stuff done. Her commitment to service runs deep, and I will be so proud to work alongside her in the U.S. Senate.
Getting her to the Senate won’t be easy. Michigan is a notorious swing state and the polls are showing her in a tight race.
But I know a little something about tough elections. My name was on the ballot five times in less than three years.
So I know Elissa can win this election. And I also know that nobody gets over the finish line alone. But when we come together and show up in full force, we elect the leaders like Elissa who will fight for a better America.
[**So if you have a few dollars to spare, please chip in to Elissa’s campaign. She cannot do this without us.**](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-em-oct24.UCjdR-&refcode=em241027-1-900&t=3&akid=2132%2E135344%2EM20Kgp)

body:
Please Join Interfaith Call | |
---
| | | __**For all faith leaders, clergy, and organizers**__ - **please** **join Vice President Harris for an interfaith conversation and call to action** **_TONIGHT – SUNDAY OCTOBER 27 from 6-7 pm ET_. **

**Please register [here](https://themaidengroup.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=417baae6ed2ee4b374c9c9805&id=38b5c15557&e=43463f1dee).**

All clergy, faith leaders, and organizers are invited to a **conversation with Vice President Harris** on the Faith for Harris-Walz [**Souls to the Polls Strategy call TONIGHT - SUNDAY October 27 from 6-7 pm ET**](https://themaidengroup.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=417baae6ed2ee4b374c9c9805&id=d4a0922a74&e=43463f1dee).

**Please [invite your community](https://themaidengroup.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=417baae6ed2ee4b374c9c9805&id=715187a72e&e=43463f1dee) to join this conversation between the Vice President and all people of faith. **Share this [flyer](https://themaidengroup.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=417baae6ed2ee4b374c9c9805&id=fd4a36ed51&e=43463f1dee) with others.

**[Vice President Harris spoke to her faith](https://themaidengroup.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=417baae6ed2ee4b374c9c9805&id=09ce720bc1&e=43463f1dee)** this past week on CNN’s Town Hall with Anderson Cooper. She spoke of how prayer gets her through her day, and that faith is about action for justice in our world. The Vice President and campaign surrogates are visiting over a hundred houses of worship this weekend to get her message out as we move through early vote.

Please _**[join Vice President Harris and other faith leaders TONIGHT from 6-7 pm ET](https://themaidengroup.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=417baae6ed2ee4b374c9c9805&id=6f542a6cf6&e=43463f1dee)**_ to bring the Harris-Walz message to your congregations and communities. You can also **share this **[**powerful video message from Vice President Harris**](https://themaidengroup.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=417baae6ed2ee4b374c9c9805&id=6de29aa0aa&e=43463f1dee)** during services, prayer breakfasts, social gatherings, broadcasts, and on social media.**

Thank you for all you’re doing. We’re praying for you.

Blessings,
The Evangelicals for Harris Team

### **1.[Bucks Dems dominated 2023 fundraising. Will the GOP catch up this year? ](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=e3491b0bd9&e=b7b3eddce2)**
_By Bradley Vasoli_
Bucks County Republicans’ prospects for regaining political power in 2023 looked promising, but Democrats won big owing largely to a vast fundraising advantage, according to a Broad + Liberty analysis of campaign finance records.

Republicans could catch up this year but only if they match the Democrats’ impressive midyear fundraising yield.

All told, the Democrats’ countywide campaign effort raked in nearly $595,000 more than the Republicans’ war chest during the 2023 election season. The gap between the two totals widens to over $858,000 when accounting for the money that all relevant county groups already had on hand from 2022.

**Why It Matters**. At first glance in 2024, it would seem Republicans won the money battle. The Bucks County Republican Committee (BCRC) raised an impressive $1,480,877.05 through November 27, 2023. The Bucks County Democratic Committee (BCDC) raised just $405,273.18 during that timespan (the start of the year through the last reporting period covering Election Day).

In reality, however, the Democrats’ county power structure was much larger owing to the fundraising prowess of Bucks United, a political action committee that took in $1.67 million during the 2023 campaign season. Registered in 2021 and headquartered in Langhorne, it has supported Democratic Bucks row-office hopefuls with media output and manpower.

That group spent copiously on campaign literature, video production, advertising airtime, online media, staff, and consultants of all kinds, including at least $4,000 on opposition research against Republican candidates.

### **2.[Why does Kamala prefer suburban voters to Philadelphians?](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=ddef5e1b9e&e=b7b3eddce2)**

_By Guy Ciarrocchi_
Kamala Harris prefers the suburbs to Philadelphia. It might cost her Pennsylvania and the Presidency.
She certainly campaigns more in the suburbs than Philly, especially recently. Now, she is trotting across the “burbs” with her new best friend, “Republican” Liz Cheney.

Harris prefers to give speeches or to participate in staged, structured events with scripts, invited audiences and little to no engagement with voters. Even when she holds “town halls,” the audience isn’t allowed to ask questions. There are pre-selected topics “of interest,” as moderators explained to puzzled audience members.

Harris gets most passionate talking about Donald Trump, nationalizing unlimited abortion rights and ironically,“saving Democracy” — so says the candidate nominated without one primary voter voting for her.

**Why It Matters**. Whether it’s ignorance, arrogance, or that she is just more comfortable with suburban voters, it’s a huge risk so far. And, with less than two weeks, any last-minute campaign stops may be too little, too late.

As news is breaking about the “big concert” being planned in Philadelphia the week before the election, some free advice for Harris: The answer is not Bruce Springsteen. Not only did this fail for Hillary, but Bruce is the wrong messenger.

Worse for her cause, staged events and shows aren’t what actual middle class and working families want. They want their gas, groceries and electricity to be cheaper and they want to feel safe walking and shopping at night and allowing their kids to play. They want schools that work, and they want school choice to allow them to have that. Why won’t she talk with these voters? And actually listen to them?

# **5\. What we're reading**
It’s tough to drop an October surprise on a candidate as well-known as Donald Trump. We already know what there is to know about him, the good, the bad, and the ugly. But, bless their hearts, the flacks at the Atlantic are going to try it anyway. This week at the _Washington Examiner_ , [David Harsanyi explains](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=f07ec30a54&e=b7b3eddce2) why the latest effort to publish an unsubstantiated (and suspiciously well-timed) rumor as fact will inevitably fail – and should diminish our trust in those who push the story. "Now, we have two anonymous sources telling us that Trump refused to pay for the funeral of a murdered Army private,” Harsanyi writes. “By now, one hopes most people understand how the game works. Goldberg published a non-falsifiable October surprise. Other outlets, unlikely to run wholly uncorroborated claims themselves, can spread the smear without verification. They did this to Justice Brett Kavanaugh. They’re going to keep doing it.”

After all, the Democrats were always planning to spend $50+ million dollars to defeat the Republican challenger. After all, we know just how ruthless and morally bankrupt Chuck Schumer and the radical democrats are. We’re in dire need of one final push from our loyal supporters and donors. Thank you in advance. Duty First, CPT Sam Brown | | Sam Brown is a retired member of the U.S. Army. Peter.

Chuck Schumer and the Democratic Senatorial Campaign Committee are now jumping into this race to rescue endangered career politician Martin Heinrich.

**They’re funneling out-of-state dollars into New Mexico to buy up precious advertising time during the final weeks and days before Election Day.**

They know they were completely caught off guard when I entered this race and have been watching nervously as we’ve gradually caught up to Heinrich in the polls.

Now, they can’t stand to sit by any longer and are frantically trying to stop our upward momentum.

With New Mexico being one of the smallest states and cheapest media markets in the 2024 fight for the Senate, the money they’ve raised from West and East Coast liberal elites stretches much further here, _which means they can do A LOT more damage with much less._

**Nella Domenici**
Republican for Senate

| **ABOUT NELLA**
**New Mexico is Nella Domenici’s home. She was born in Albuquerque and lived for most of her childhood in a home near the intersection of Lomas and Monroe with her seven siblings, and her parents - Pete and Nancy Domenici. Nella began her education at Our Lady of Fatima, where she learned the values she holds today. Nella is a proud third-generation New Mexican, devoted mother of two, step-mom of four, and the wife of a Navy Veteran. Nella’s family’s roots run deep in New Mexico and she and her husband Pat enjoy their family home in New Mexico that they have owned for nearly twenty years.

Like most New Mexicans, Nella Domenici understands the importance of hard work. She waited tables to help pay for her undergraduate degree from Georgetown University, and worked her way through night school at Georgetown Law while holding down a full time job. She then graduated from Harvard Business School as a Baker Scholar, top 5% of the class, while 9 months pregnant.

Nella began her career at the bottom and worked her way up through the complex finance world, eventually serving as CFO for one of the world’s largest, most successful investment firms. In her career, Nella advised, invested in, grew, and led many companies, and served on public company boards. The industries she has worked in are vast and include areas such as health care, AI, food service, lodging, commercial real estate, mortgage lending, and consumer products. These companies have ranged from small family-owned businesses, to rapidly growing venture backed enterprises, to a Fortune 200 company. Several of these have been headquartered in New Mexico. Collectively, the companies Nella has been heavily involved with have employed thousands of Americans.

Like her father and mother, Nella has been a warrior for those who most need an advocate: for women competing in academics or business, for families dealing with mental illness, and for those without access to quality healthcare or education. **

name: Ilhan Omar for Congress
subject: Following up on Ilhan’s message
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY ILHAN FOR CONGRESS
body:
As many of us are focused on the election, the situation in Gaza continues to worsen.
# [](https://act.ilhanomar.com/go/35?t=1&akid=1375%2E791427%2E_UcR3d)

Friend — We know it’s a busy time.
GOTV is in full swing. Election Day is almost a week away. We know your inbox is probably full of requests from campaigns like ours.
But we wanted to bump Ilhan’s message from last week, because it’s not a run-of-the-mill fundraising ask.
As many of us are focused on the election, **the situation in Gaza continues to worsen.** Civilians in North Gaza have gone weeks now without any access to humanitarian aid including food and water, while the Israeli military continues to bomb civilian areas and force families to leave at gunpoint.
That’s why Ilhan has called on this team to show their support for an arms embargo on Israel until a real, lasting ceasefire is reached — the US cannot continue to be complicit in Netanyahu and the Israeli military’s war crimes.
The good news is that we saw an **_outpouring**_ of support after Ilhan reached out last week. Thousands of folks signed their name to our petition and made it clear that not another bomb should be sent to Israel for their genocide of Palestinians in Gaza and their assault on Lebanon.
Now we’re asking if you can sign your name, too, and help us keep up that momentum.
**[So please: Add your name to our petition calling on the Biden administration to cut off military aid to Netanyahu’s war on Palestinians. Every day that we delay this necessary step is another day of danger for those in Gaza.](https://act.ilhanomar.com/signup/em-oct24-gaza-petition/?source=em241027-1-30&refcode2=1375.791427._UcR3d&akid=1375%2E791427%2E_UcR3d)**
**[ADD YOUR NAME](https://act.ilhanomar.com/signup/em-oct24-gaza-petition/?source=em241027-1-30&refcode2=1375.791427._UcR3d&akid=1375%2E791427%2E_UcR3d)**
We’re going to have to walk and chew gum at the same time. We have an election to win, but ending the genocide in Gaza must remain at the top of our agenda. We thank you for any help you can give today.
In solidarity,
Team Ilhan

name: Lucas Kunce
subject: This is what happens when a U.S. Senator doesn’t do their job
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Lucas Kunce for Missouri
body:
#
Peter — this is what happens when a U.S. Senator doesn’t do their job.
Black bootheel towns like Hayti Heights are unable to afford fixing their water treatment plant. Neighborhoods like where I grew up on East Dunklin Street don’t have enough to rebuild broken-down, boarded-up houses. Plant closures in Marston and across Missouri leaving whole towns and counties devastated with no plans or money to bring in new jobs.
When I was overseas, our leaders were spending trillions of dollars making us fight and nation build out there — in places like Habbaniyah, Fallujah, and Helmand. They should have been investing in towns like Hayti Heights and Marston, or left-behind neighborhoods across Missouri.
**We need a U.S. Senator who will invest in our state.** But Josh Hawley's voted against sending federal dollars to Missouri almost every chance he's had. He's literally NEVER made a request for Congressionally directed spending for ANY community in Missouri.
In the Senate, I'll fight to bring home every dollar I can to Missouri. I'll invest in us. But I can’t do it without your help.

name: Elizabeth Warren
subject: Republicans bringing up the fact that they have daughters
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Warren for Senate
body:
| | | [ ](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/216?t=3&akid=2387%2E4032634%2EyTpWOv)
---
A way Republican politicians try to sound moderate on abortion rights is by bringing up the fact that they have daughters. _“Oh, I couldn’t take away reproductive rights, I’ve got a daughter.”_ Well, look, the Supreme Court Justices that overturned _Roe v. Wade_ collectively have 10 daughters. Donald Trump — who brags about ending _Roe v. Wade_ — has two daughters (that we know of). History tells us that having daughters does not pre-qualify powerful decision makers to be reproductive rights advocates. So you can imagine why some people don’t trust that defense. This is truly a question of trust — and when it comes to trust, actions speak louder than words about daughters. Keep in mind that right now, 30% of all women — daughters — live in a state that effectively bans access to abortion due to Donald Trump’s actions. And if Trump and Vance make it to the White House, it won't be 30%. They will aim for it to be 100%. Republicans and right-wing extremists are coming after abortion everywhere in this country. They're coming after IVF in this country, and they're coming after contraception — birth control, IUDs, Plan B, everything. Not just in red states, but nationally — red states, blue states, purple states, everywhere. They’ve told us — and shown us — that they will. They've told us this in Project 2025. JD Vance told us this when he wrote a letter to the Department of Justice showing them how to ban abortion nationally without a vote in the Senate. House and Senate Republicans have said they are going for a nationwide abortion ban. Senate Republicans have blocked IVF protections from passing through Congress not once, but TWICE now. We all watched as one after another Republican nominee for the Supreme Court walked in front of the United States Senate and swore until the world looked level that they would respect precedent, which was supposed to be code for they would not overturn _Roe v. Wade_. And then the first opportunity they got, they set _Roe v. Wade_ on fire and burned it to ash. When we talk about abortion laws, we are talking about the lives of our daughters. Daughters and granddaughters who deserve full autonomy over their bodies instead of politicians “who have daughters” controlling them. Women are not stupid. Republicans can try to soften their anti-abortion stances all they want, but, we know not to trust the futures of our daughters and granddaughters to the Republican party. If you agree, then vote for Kamala Harris and Tim Walz. Vote for the pro-choice Democrats down your ballot. Forward this message to your friends and family. If Democrats have pro-choice majorities in the House and Senate and we have Kamala Harris in the White House, we will pass a law securing the right to an abortion nationwide. I’m going to keep fighting like hell to get this done. For our daughters and granddaughters, Elizabeth

clean_body: | | | Knock, knock, knock. It’s the scariest sound you’ll hear when you live in a communist country. It’s the last sound my parents heard when their fathers were taken away. It’s the sound of always living in fear, and it’s my family’s real-life story. We escaped from Vietnam just days before Saigon fell to the communists, and we were given a new life in the most generous country on Earth. America saved my life, and I dedicated my life to paying her back. I graduated from the United States Naval Academy and served for 25 years in Navy Special Operations in Iraq, Afghanistan, Somalia, and Pakistan and 40 other countries around the world. I love this country - but right now, it’s taken a dark turn. Now, the knocks are coming from Joe Biden’s Department of Justice. Sending two dozen armed agents to arrest a pro-life activist in front of his family. Raiding gun shops and seizing records from law-abiding gun owners. Arresting his challenger in the next election. And he’s doing it all while real criminals are free to roam our streets. We are losing our country. You know it. But you also know we can save it. I’ve been all over the world. Believe me when I tell you, if America fails, there is nowhere else to go. It’s time to save America while we still have a chance. I’m Hung Cao, retired Navy Captain, and I’m running for the United States Senate. I still believe America can be the land of opportunity, Fellow Patriot. And as someone who owes their life to the American Dream, I have an obligation to fight back against those who have trampled on it. We need REAL fighters. Not politicians, not bureaucrats, and not keyboard warriors acting tough in custom made suits. If we’re going to preserve our freedoms, we can’t be intimidated. We must be fearless. Let’s win this. It’s been an insanely busy week over here - so busy that I almost forgot to send you this email (oops). But I want to make sure I keep you updated on our race and where things stand.
It’s been a long road. As one of the Democrats who flipped a seat from red to blue in 2018, I’ve had a target on my back from the very first day I was sworn in.
And with a serious opponent this year and the demographics in our district trending towards Trump, Republicans have always seen this as one of their best opportunities to flip a California seat.
So it’s been a hard fight. But it’s been worth it because of you.
Now we are in the home stretch and the outcome of this race will come down to what we can do these last few days. It’s really that close. Speaker Mike Johnson and MAGA Republicans just helped our opponent launch a final attack ad and our opponent is capitalizing on this momentum.

And as a citizen with a platform larger than most, I believe it is not only my right but also my duty to express my concerns. So here goes Peter: **I’m concerned by what I’m seeing in Pennsylvania and national Republicans’ ruthless efforts to unseat Bob Casey and flip this battleground red.** If the GOP succeeds in flipping Pennsylvania red, they’ll almost certainly regain control of both the Senate _and_ the White House, threatening everything from voting rights to women’s rights to the fight against climate change. That’s why outside interest groups have started spending upwards of $150 million to defeat Bob. The stakes this November are higher than ever before. **[So before I go on, can you please split a donation between Bob’s re-election campaign and Defeat Boebert PAC?](http://links.defeatboebertpac.com/u/click?_t=c3d87ac674644038b5146447a156028d&_m=e7981dc65d8848d681f367dbc0b5e3ea&_e=-fazsAjdvC9arit3rYZX7jDJ1Fi1YlPfJGApq5KFjAUMxOmPr9iiDsEG4t3rO01bEb4FAP79UcDEYdbCQMWo4M04kR5464XQu3l1772bSLAyvQOu7fqv9DK2_BTx6rzrbKLXohW9h01yOUCQxFU_OXNjKleWG1jV_ZDL6YCul194jMPhB52a7D6qP9IhVIpnxzvDcjJbOBqwk23MrumnKTVLQUbMEn0xLhkM8fdXRpFFz5hF8M_QIOantdS3vWeVoChyrwKwPL-mljL03o7SdWWfdjZMq6JTvowyUTSRv72lI6V1CNehSbGH6YWI6tHT3E2kvTWxeQ_FCe4n87j7ZbWa8xW4DKZ0NQk8pPkZEfGbK9XaQ9irteRCzpz7X69w-8FptPCSsz81WkQk0vpk__lmPtNZUZ5IwPMszcGTcxcbf2t189DVJMfwf-37V7mv)** ****[**DONATE NOW >>**](http://links.defeatboebertpac.com/u/click?_t=c3d87ac674644038b5146447a156028d&_m=e7981dc65d8848d681f367dbc0b5e3ea&_e=-fazsAjdvC9arit3rYZX7jDJ1Fi1YlPfJGApq5KFjAUMxOmPr9iiDsEG4t3rO01bEb4FAP79UcDEYdbCQMWo4M04kR5464XQu3l1772bSLAyvQOu7fqv9DK2_BTx6rzrbKLXohW9h01yOUCQxFU_OXNjKleWG1jV_ZDL6YCul194jMPhB52a7D6qP9IhVIpnxzvDcjJbOBqwk23MrumnKTVLQUbMEn0xLhkM8fdXRpFFz5hF8M_QIOantdS3vWeVBhOzXJM-nYpzi9n-74r0R6IkkBwpXuVvKb40pGTjgU3hT_2LnvtR2cgTsTRoNbmtwzswYZ3t9zOnPYXHE7apdVBstNGegSKdBZGKTJzZdAOX2hTXX8sYSjES-S-vybHopMP7aYB0Aa3razUZqR3ENv_YajaMyOvlfPojqwW4aaNsw3oZlCiLNKdkjTenEXr9)**** I’m committed to electing lawmakers like Bob Casey, who believes that everyone deserves a fair shot at getting ahead and staying ahead. Chuck Schumer and the Democratic Senatorial Campaign Committee are now jumping into this race to rescue endangered career politician Martin Heinrich.

**They’re funneling out-of-state dollars into New Mexico to buy up precious advertising time during the final weeks and days before Election Day.**

They know they were completely caught off guard when I entered this race and have been watching nervously as we’ve gradually caught up to Heinrich in the polls.

Now, they can’t stand to sit by any longer and are frantically trying to stop our upward momentum.

With New Mexico being one of the smallest states and cheapest media markets in the 2024 fight for the Senate, the money they’ve raised from West and East Coast liberal elites stretches much further here, _which means they can do A LOT more damage with much less._

| **ABOUT NELLA**
**New Mexico is Nella Domenici’s home. She was born in Albuquerque and lived for most of her childhood in a home near the intersection of Lomas and Monroe with her seven siblings, and her parents - Pete and Nancy Domenici. Nella began her education at Our Lady of Fatima, where she learned the values she holds today. Nella is a proud third-generation New Mexican, devoted mother of two, step-mom of four, and the wife of a Navy Veteran. Nella’s family’s roots run deep in New Mexico and she and her husband Pat enjoy their family home in New Mexico that they have owned for nearly twenty years.

Like most New Mexicans, Nella Domenici understands the importance of hard work. She waited tables to help pay for her undergraduate degree from Georgetown University, and worked her way through night school at Georgetown Law while holding down a full time job. She then graduated from Harvard Business School as a Baker Scholar, top 5% of the class, while 9 months pregnant.

Nella began her career at the bottom and worked her way up through the complex finance world, eventually serving as CFO for one of the world’s largest, most successful investment firms. In her career, Nella advised, invested in, grew, and led many companies, and served on public company boards. The industries she has worked in are vast and include areas such as health care, AI, food service, lodging, commercial real estate, mortgage lending, and consumer products. These companies have ranged from small family-owned businesses, to rapidly growing venture backed enterprises, to a Fortune 200 company. Several of these have been headquartered in New Mexico. Collectively, the companies Nella has been heavily involved with have employed thousands of Americans.

Like her father and mother, Nella has been a warrior for those who most need an advocate: for women competing in academics or business, for families dealing with mental illness, and for those without access to quality healthcare or education. **

As Election Day gets closer (just nine days to go!), I’ve been thinking about our race in 2022. By this point two years ago, our people-powered campaign had been outspent 6:1. We were scrambling to cut through my opponent’s out-of-state money to reach voters with our pro-choice, pro-water, pro-democracy message. A lot of people didn’t think we’d have a chance. But we proved them wrong when we came within a percentage point of winning. The first step in making sure we win this time around is preventing Republicans from buying this seat again. **Because of your incredible grassroots support and momentum, we’ve managed to mostly keep up with my opponent and his super PAC allies. But in the final weeks of this campaign, we’ve been falling behind.** [**Crypto, Big Banks, and the House GOP’s super PACs have spent millions on our opponent. Friend, Last week, our Jewish neighbors finished celebrating Sukkot, a weeklong holiday marked by spending time in sacred outdoor structures called sukkahs. Jewish students on more than 20 campuses across the country set up sukkahs for Palestine, demanding their universities divest from genocide and calling for an end to weapons shipments to Israel. But multiple university administrators shamefully directed police officers to destroy and desecrate these sukkahs, trampling yet again on students’ rights. **As campuses escalate repression during this fall semester, I want to lift up Palestine Legal, the only legal organization focused on protecting advocates for Palestinian rights.** The group’s mission is to bolster the Palestine solidarity movement by challenging efforts to threaten, harass, and legally bully activists into silence and inaction. Palestine Legal also exposes this repression for what it is: an effort to shield Israel from accountability and justify U.S. support for atrocities. **Palestine Legal has seen an unprecedented spike in repression targeting Palestinians and their supporters in the United States. In the last year, the organization received nearly 3,000 requests for legal support—which is over ten times the number of requests from the previous year.** This year Palestine Legal has advised and represented activists in need, sued schools for their discriminatory and unconstitutional actions, and filed 10 federal civil rights complaints against universities for severe anti-Palestinian discrimination in violation of Title VI of the Civil Rights Act. Thanks to their work, student groups in multiple states have been able to continue operating on-campus, five schools are now under federal investigation, and many universities have dropped charges and complaints against pro-Palestine students and professors. * **When he talks, his supporters listen.** They listened when he spread the Big Lie on January 6th -- and we all know what happened next.
* **He's the de facto leader of the GOP.** Nearly every Republican official looks to him for money, influence, and approval.

**And that's exactly why we can't let his MAGA allies take back the Senate majority. If Donald loses the White House but the GOP takes back the Senate, he'll turn it into a new, alternative power center -- through which he'll _continue_ to attack our freedoms.**

name: Debbie Mucarsel-Powell
subject: My favorite weekend activity!
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Lucas Kunce for Missouri
body:
Friend, every Sunday my mom and I spend the afternoon playing dominoes together. It's our special tradition — and it's one of the most meaningful parts of my life.
[](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/80665?refcode=em20241027-8237&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=8237%2E614464%2EexJR3T)
I owe just about everything in my life to my mom. She made the brave decision to move my family from our home in Ecuador to America. It wasn't easy moving to a new country as a 14-year-old, but I can't imagine what it was like for my mom, having to start all over and working double shifts just to pay rent for a one room apartment.
But friend, my mom never wavered once. **Her constant reassurance, work ethic, and firm belief in the American dream inspired me to fight for a better life.**
I studied hard, got a minimum wage job, and earned scholarships to pay for college. After school, I found a career giving back to my community through public service, eventually becoming the first South American immigrant elected to Congress. I've found purpose in my life, become part of a unique community, and raised a beautiful family.
**Because of my mom's sacrifices, my family got our American dream. And now, it's both a privilege and a joy to be my mom's caretaker, ensuring that she can age with dignity and comfort.** There are a lot of big things that come along with that job — managing her doctor's appointments, advocating for her care, and navigating the all-too-complicated Medicare and Social Security systems.
But it's the little parts of caring for my mom — playing our weekly domino games, cooking a big dinner for her, taking her on trips to her favorite places — that matter most to me.
My ability to give my mom a good retirement is one of the things that I am most grateful for. It's not easy by any means, but I know all too well just how lucky my mom and I are. **These days, it's getting harder and harder for Americans to age with dignity and comfort.**
Far-right Republicans have fought for major cuts to Social Security and blocked efforts to expand Medicare, leaving seniors living paycheck to paycheck. Instead they want to cut or privatize these critical public programs — my opponent Rick Scott actually came up with a plan to end them altogether. Even though I've been able to give my mom a good retirement, the shortcomings of these programs still make it incredibly hard to get her the care and support she needs.
**Every American deserves a good, stable retirement. That's why I'm running for Senate — to fight for people like my mom.[Polls show that we've got a real chance to win, but I'm counting on your help to power my grassroots campaign. Please, if you believe in a better future for seniors, will you split $10 between me and Lucas Kunce to help me defeat Rick Scott and protect Social Security and Medicare?](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/80665?refcode=em20241027-8237&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&akid=8237%2E614464%2EexJR3T)

In a climate where legacy media, like the LA Times and Washington Post, sidestep endorsing a clear choice between Donald Trump and Vice President Kamala Harris, their neutrality speaks volumes--and not in a way that serves democracy. Their refusal to take a stance, despite Trump's outright embrace of fascism, leaves many readers feeling abandoned. Thousands of subscribers are canceling their memberships in response. But it cannot stop here. This moment calls us to seek sources that prioritize justice and fundamental human rights. **Let 's Address This.**
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/6f991036-4eef-4a22-a447-ad5db46f86d6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|

## Where Legacy Media is Failing
As the old saying goes, "**The hottest places in hell are reserved for those who, in times of great moral crisis, maintain their neutrality**." Mainstream media outlets often claim to be the gatekeepers of truth, yet their unwillingness to denounce clear threats to democracy shows an unfortunate capitulation to both-sides-ism. And it isn't just the LA Times or Washington Post. CNN famously refused to fact check Donald Trump during his debate against President Biden. CBS also refused to fact check the VP debate. This capitulation reveals the painful truth: traditional media is prioritizing neutrality over justice--even when such neutrality emboldens those who threaten our nation's most vulnerable. We cannot sit idle, and we do not have to.
### My Pledge to You
In an era where journalists and publications may tiptoe around hard truths, I promise you that _Let 's Address This_ will continue to stand as a firm, unflinching voice for justice. With every issue, I'm committed to bringing you stories that matter--unclouded by partisanship and deeply rooted in the values of human rights, integrity, and honesty. Here, you'll find content that champions accountability, justice, and transparency, speaking out against injustice wherever it exists.
Every subscriber to _Let 's Address This_ strengthens our ability to advocate for a more just world and demand a better media landscape. Together, we can demand accountability from leaders and hold ourselves and our institutions to the highest standards of truth.

### Why Your Support Matters
As we witness these gaps widening in traditional media's commitment to democratic principles, every dollar we spend is a vote for the future we want to build. Join the 75,000 others who support a vision for change rooted in truth, justice, and equity. Your support isn't just a subscription; it's a step toward reshaping the very landscape of how we engage with the truth.

Thank you for standing with us in this crucial fight for a future where our voices matter, and where our advocacy serves to protect working people--not to appease maniacal billionaires.

Hello,
Every time I see a new attack on abortion rights and women’s reproductive freedoms, I think of my dad.
For the first few years of my life, my family lived on an Indian reservation in Northern Montana. Dad was an OB-GYN – in the years before _Roe v. Wade_ ...
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/95934449/508367621/1610638071?refcode=em20241027mid-nd&amounts=5%2C10%2C25%2C35%2C50%2C100%2C250&refcode2=de9e7887-7c94-ef11-88ce-000d3a98fa6b&recurring=true&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NjIxNiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkZTllNzg4Ny03Yzk0LWVmMTEtODhjZS0wMDBkM2E5OGZhNmIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=d6I0DUZnfvXbuGC7jwBLcp2ldPPpvz-Zxfc4Y9Qzdp8=)
Years later, Dad recounted how he saw patients that came from all walks of life. Black, brown, and white. Younger and older. Rich and poor. And just as many Republicans walked through his doors as did Democrats.
Looking back, having a father who provided women with access to health care – especially at a time when so many were being denied the right – really shaped how I think about the issue.
My dad is in his 80’s and retired now, but for years, he helped train the next generation of health care providers at Planned Parenthood. And my sister, who later also became an OB-GYN, is continuing on his legacy.
**Extremists like Lauren Boebert and my new Republican opponent want you to think that women having the freedom to make their own medical decisions is some extreme idea. It’s not.**
What’s extreme is pushing a bill in Congress that would make all abortions illegal – including in cases of rape or incest – and wanting to ban a medication that’s been approved for decades for abortions and miscarriages.
Their views are a fringe one – supported by people who think that the government should be dictating women’s medical decisions, instead of allowing women the freedom to make choices with their doctor.
I would have thought that after almost losing this seat last year, they might have at least pretended to moderate on this issue. But they've only doubled down on the extreme.
**Only 546 votes separated Lauren Boebert and me in 2022, and I’m ready to finish the job in 2024 by winning this seat in Congress.**

| **ABOUT NELLA**
**New Mexico is Nella Domenici’s home. She was born in Albuquerque and lived for most of her childhood in a home near the intersection of Lomas and Monroe with her seven siblings, and her parents - Pete and Nancy Domenici. Nella began her education at Our Lady of Fatima, where she learned the values she holds today. Nella is a proud third-generation New Mexican, devoted mother of two, step-mom of four, and the wife of a Navy Veteran. Nella’s family’s roots run deep in New Mexico and she and her husband Pat enjoy their family home in New Mexico that they have owned for nearly twenty years.

Like most New Mexicans, Nella Domenici understands the importance of hard work. She waited tables to help pay for her undergraduate degree from Georgetown University, and worked her way through night school at Georgetown Law while holding down a full time job. She then graduated from Harvard Business School as a Baker Scholar, top 5% of the class, while 9 months pregnant.

Nella began her career at the bottom and worked her way up through the complex finance world, eventually serving as CFO for one of the world’s largest, most successful investment firms. In her career, Nella advised, invested in, grew, and led many companies, and served on public company boards. The industries she has worked in are vast and include areas such as health care, AI, food service, lodging, commercial real estate, mortgage lending, and consumer products. These companies have ranged from small family-owned businesses, to rapidly growing venture backed enterprises, to a Fortune 200 company. Several of these have been headquartered in New Mexico. Collectively, the companies Nella has been heavily involved with have employed thousands of Americans.

Like her father and mother, Nella has been a warrior for those who most need an advocate: for women competing in academics or business, for families dealing with mental illness, and for those without access to quality healthcare or education. **

They’re funneling out-of-state dollars into New Mexico to buy up precious advertising time during the final weeks and days before Election Day. They know they were completely caught off guard when I entered this race and have been watching nervously as we’ve gradually caught up to Heinrich in the polls. Now, they can’t stand to sit by any longer and are frantically trying to stop our upward momentum. With New Mexico being one of the smallest states and cheapest media markets in the 2024 fight for the Senate, the money they’ve raised from West and East Coast liberal elites stretches much further here, which means they can do A LOT more damage with much less. But that also means your support goes much further here, We’ve never been so close to flipping a “safe blue” state, and I need every bit of support you can send down the home stretch. Let’s keep up the fight! Nella Domenici Republican for Senate | ABOUT NELLA New Mexico is Nella Domenici’s home. She was born in Albuquerque and lived for most of her childhood in a home near the intersection of Lomas and Monroe with her seven siblings, and her parents - Pete and Nancy Domenici. Nella began her education at Our Lady of Fatima, where she learned the values she holds today. Nella is a proud third-generation New Mexican, devoted mother of two, step-mom of four, and the wife of a Navy Veteran. Nella’s family’s roots run deep in New Mexico and she and her husband Pat enjoy their family home in New Mexico that they have owned for nearly twenty years. Like most New Mexicans, Nella Domenici understands the importance of hard work. She waited tables to help pay for her undergraduate degree from Georgetown University, and worked her way through night school at Georgetown Law while holding down a full time job. She then graduated from Harvard Business School as a Baker Scholar, top 5% of the class, while 9 months pregnant. Nella began her career at the bottom and worked her way up through the complex finance world, eventually serving as CFO for one of the world’s largest, most successful investment firms. In her career, Nella advised, invested in, grew, and led many companies, and served on public company boards. The industries she has worked in are vast and include areas such as health care, AI, food service, lodging, commercial real estate, mortgage lending, and consumer products. These companies have ranged from small family-owned businesses, to rapidly growing venture backed enterprises, to a Fortune 200 company. Several of these have been headquartered in New Mexico. Collectively, the companies Nella has been heavily involved with have employed thousands of Americans. Like her father and mother, Nella has been a warrior for those who most need an advocate: for women competing in academics or business, for families dealing with mental illness, and for those without access to quality healthcare or education. body:
Our votes are powerful tools to protect our communities and keep our democracy strong.
#

Team -
As Election Day approaches, and early voting is already underway, let’s focus on what matters most: showing up and making our voices heard. Our votes are powerful tools to protect our communities and keep our democracy strong.
This election cycle, election officials and poll workers are facing unprecedented threats of violence and intimidation. Despite the challenges, they’re stepping up to make sure every vote is counted. They’re committed to ensuring a fair and safe process because that’s how we defend our democracy—by showing up.
[**We are hard at work at GIFFORDS to prevent political violence and protect our right to vote. If you’re ready to help fuel this work, please make a $3 contribution today.**](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giffords-em-oct24.iFm2sk&refcode=em2401027-1-30&t=1&akid=9296%2E3935704%2EcdHs9q)
While election officials work tirelessly to ensure a safe and accessible voting process, there’s a lot we can do, too. Whether you’re voting early or on Election Day, remember that your right to vote is protected. If you encounter any challenges or feel uncertain, the Election Protection Hotline at 1-866-687-8683 is there to help.
GIFFORDS is working every day to push back against the dangerous influence of the gun lobby in our political system, ensuring that every American can vote without fear.
[**We will not rest until we have ended the gun industry’s dangerous influence on our political system once and for all. Will you make a donation of $3 today to help fuel this critical work, especially as Election Day approaches rapidly?**](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giffords-em-oct24.iFm2sk&refcode=em2401027-1-30&t=2&akid=9296%2E3935704%2EcdHs9q)

### Hillary Really Hasn't Accomplished Anything

A few weeks ago, I first shared a stage with Nancy Mace at a public forum where I called her out for her anti-choice, anti-environment, anti-democracy track record — and now she’s ON THE RUN. Here’s what you need to know: 1️⃣ For the first time in this election, voters saw **IN REAL TIME** the difference between my plan for progress v. Nancy’s MAGA agenda — and folks heard it loud and clear. 2️⃣ She knows that in order to win, she’s got to HIDE from her horrible voting record. That’s why she **BACKED OUT** of upcoming debates that would let undecided voters know just how extremist she is. 3️⃣ If Mace won’t be clear where she stands, we’ve got to do it ourselves. # FROM THE DESK OF ALAN DERSHOWITZ
---
| | Dear Reader, In over sixty years in the legal profession, I've experienced first hand the impact of both good journalism and bad journalism — mostly the latter — and just how important and rare it is to get things right.

**In today's media landscape there are far too many publications that get things wrong.** Many are more concerned with the political implications of a story than the basic facts.

**The New York Sun is different.** It's a paper that places principle over politics and people over party.

Its in-depth coverage of the legal challenges faced by President Trump serve as a case in point.

When I defended President Trump during his first impeachment, I faced an avalanche of criticism, but few papers made sufficient effort to fully appreciate the significance of the legal arguments.

The Sun's deeply knowledgeable leadership, including its editor Seth Lipsky and associate editor A.R. Hoffman are themselves students of the Constitution. It shows in their coverage, which I find to be first rate.

It will be no secret to you that I don't agree with everything that can be found in the Sun's pages, but I can say with confidence that its re-emergence is among the most important recent developments in American journalism.

I've been impressed by the Sun's growth so far, but I know it faces an uphill battle, one that I have pledged to join.

**The Sun's success will be a gift to the American people and to the cause of truth.** But to succeed, we need you to join us. I highly encourage you to join the Sun today.

Every person matters in this effort.

Don't wait. The battle to restore American journalism starts now.

For a limited time, join for just 1¢. | | | | FROM THE DESK OF ALAN DERSHOWITZ | | Dear Reader, In over sixty years in the legal profession, I've experienced first hand the impact of both good journalism and bad journalism — mostly the latter — and just how important and rare it is to get things right. In today's media landscape there are far too many publications that get things wrong. Many are more concerned with the political implications of a story than the basic facts. The New York Sun is different. It's a paper that places principle over politics and people over party. Its in-depth coverage of the legal challenges faced by President Trump serve as a case in point. When I defended President Trump during his first impeachment, I faced an avalanche of criticism, but few papers made sufficient effort to fully appreciate the significance of the legal arguments. The Sun's deeply knowledgeable leadership, including its editor Seth Lipsky and associate editor A.R. Hoffman are themselves students of the Constitution. It shows in their coverage, which I find to be first rate. It will be no secret to you that I don't agree with everything that can be found in the Sun's pages, but I can say with confidence that its re-emergence is among the most important recent developments in American journalism. I've been impressed by the Sun's growth so far, but I know it faces an uphill battle, one that I have pledged to join. The Sun's success will be a gift to the American people and to the cause of truth. But to succeed, we need you to join us. I highly encourage you to join the Sun today. clean_body: Kamala Harris faces intense scrutiny while Trump gets a pass Peter, On Wednesday, Kamala Harris joined Anderson Cooper for a CNN town hall with undecided voters. Both Trump and Harris were invited to participate, but while Harris showed up, Trump declined—just as he has with every debate after the first. You’d think CNN might give Harris credit for taking questions, especially after the media criticized her campaign early on for fewer appearances. Instead, CNN’s Dana Bash gave this alarming take: “Some people have asked: Is she being held to a different standard? Maybe. But that’s maybe the world that she’s living in.” = The double standard runs deep. When President Biden stumbled in a debate, media across The New York Times , The Washington Post , and CNN , MSNBC , and Fox News called for him to step aside, raising questions about age and mental fitness. And when he passed the torch, scrutiny quickly shifted to Harris, echoing right-wing talking points critiquing her for fewer media appearances or supposed policy gaps. Contrast this with coverage of Trump, who ranted about immigrants eating pets in a disastrous debate, recently canceled events due to “exhaustion,” paused mid-rally to dance to music for over 40 minutes, and bizarrely discussed the size of Arnold Palmer’s anatomy. Yet, the same media that grills Harris and Biden is strangely silent on Trump’s behavior, instead normalizing his authoritarian candidacy. The result? Harris faces relentless scrutiny while Trump’s antics go unchecked—a clear example of pro-Trump media bias that we urgently need to counterbalance. = Express Donate: If you've stored your info with ActBlue Express, we'll process your contribution instantly: | = | = | = | = ---|---|---|--- Thank you, COURIER Email us: mailto:info@couriernewsroom.com

First, the good news: Since early voting began, Georgia has seen record-breaking turnout — more than 1.4 million votes were cast in the first week alone, a fifth of the state’s voting population. Now, the not-so-good news: **Georgians are still voting on an unfair congressional map that gives Republican candidates a significant advantage** — a map that was drawn up by, you guessed it, the Republican-controlled general assembly. **Michelle Kang is running for Georgia’s 99th state house district — with a real chance to flip the seat blue.** A first-generation Korean-American and small business owner, Michelle wants to lower housing costs, protect reproductive freedom, and create jobs and job training opportunities for families in her district. Her opponent, a first-term Republican incumbent, believes abortion should be illegal. No thanks!
**In Georgia’s 48th state house district, Laura Murvartian is running to unseat another Republican incumbent.** Laura is a business executive and nonprofit leader who moved to the U.S. at age 8. She prioritizes defending reproductive rights, enacting smart gun control, making health care more affordable, and ensuring the economy works for working people.
**And finally, Susie Greenberg is running in Georgia’s 53rd state house district, challenging a Republican incumbent in what’s been called the “most flippable” seat in Georgia's state house.** Susie’s platform centers on restoring reproductive freedoms in Georgia, creating safer communities and stronger public schools, ensuring access to quality, affordable health care, and strengthening the economy for all Georgians.
Georgians would be fortunate to have Michelle, Laura, and Susie representing them in the state house — more champions for our democracy who would move Georgia closer to electoral maps that truly represent the will of the people.

[1]Justice Democrats

Peter,

Last weekend, Israeli forces intensified their genocide in Gaza and
violent attacks against Lebanon — we cannot look away or ignore this.

In northern Gaza, more than 400,000 displaced and starving Palestinians
who are trapped with nowhere to go are being forced to leave or die. The
Israeli military has not only continued bombing and shooting Palestinians
taking shelter in refugee camps, hospitals, and schools, but it also
separated men and boys from women, blindfolding and binding their arms,
with reports of many being arrested, tortured, or killed.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/signup/petition-20241027-arms-embargo/?source=em20241027-36099&akid=36099%2E1203867%2EOeNTOs ]Tweet by @HossamShabat: Israeli occupation forces continue ethnically
cleansing the north. Today, they attacked a school in the Jabalia refugee
camp and forced people out of it. Then they lined them up and shot anyone
who dared to move. Any male over the age of 16 is being detained,
tortured, and investigated. Many people who are being lined up are sick
individuals, such as amputees, cancer patients, and young kids who are
being asked to stand in line for hours. The situation is catastrophic.

Israel is carrying out its final stage of ethnic cleansing in northern
Gaza while the world watches and our government provides the bombs and
weapons to do it.

Meanwhile, the Israeli military is wreaking similar havoc in Lebanon,
using the same strategy they’ve used in Gaza over the past year. Last
week, thousands of Lebanese civilians were sent into a panic after Israel
issued last-minute evacuation warnings to residential communities in
Beirut and southern Lebanon. Israel then proceeded to bomb these densely
populated areas overnight, including near Beirut’s international airport.

The UN says more than 400,000 Lebanese children — almost 10% of the entire
country’s population — have been displaced due to Israel’s attacks.

Israel’s far-right government led by genocidal Prime Minister Netanyahu
cannot continue to go unchecked like this,
Peter.

The Biden administration said that it’s giving Israel 30 days to improve
the situation, but it continues providing billions of dollars worth of
bombs and weapons and is even sending U.S. troops to serve alongside the
IDF, likely violating the Leahy Law and the War Powers Act.

We cannot wait until after the election to stop this genocide.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/signup/petition-20241027-arms-embargo/?source=em20241027-36099&akid=36099%2E1203867%2EOeNTOs ]Add your name to tell the Biden administration: stop violating U.S. and
international law by arming and enabling Israel’s genocide — we demand an
arms embargo NOW!

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/signup/petition-20241027-arms-embargo/?source=em20241027-36099&akid=36099%2E1203867%2EOeNTOs ]Add Your Name

In solidarity,

subject: A new and exciting twist to Sundays with my mom

body:
Well, this Sunday — today — just got a whole lot more meaningful.
| | |
---
Friend — Sundays are always special in my household because of my mom. We usually spend the afternoon playing dominoes together. It's a simple but special Sunday tradition that has brought so much meaning to my life.
Well, this Sunday — _today_ — just got a whole lot more meaningful. **Today my mom and I are voting early, where we will cast our ballots to elect me as Florida's next U.S. Senator and retire extremist Rick Scott for good. **We'll also be joined by my husband, Robert, my sisters, and my kids. 🩷
With just 9 days left of this election, polls show me tied with Rick Scott and on the cusp of pulling off one of the greatest political upsets in history. I owe this moment, and just about everything in my life, to my mom.

You see, my mom, sisters, and I lived under a dictatorship in Ecuador. It was my mom who made the brave decision to move us to America, knowing that if she worked hard, then she could give her kids equal opportunity to succeed and build their own American dream.

She was right. But it wasn't easy. My mom had to start all over in a new country where she didn't know the language. She worked double shifts just to pay rent for a one room apartment while taking English lessons in the evening and on weekends. Despite the difficulties, my mom never wavered.

**It's my mom's constant reassurance, work ethic, and firm belief in the American dream that inspired me to fight for a better life — and inspired me to run for U.S. Senate.**
My mom's sacrifices enabled us to live out our own American dream. Now, it's both a privilege and joy to be my mom's caretaker, ensuring she can age with dignity and comfort. In fact, my ability to give my mom a good retirement is one of the things that I am most grateful for. It's not easy by any means, but I know all too well just how lucky my mom and I are.

These days, it's getting harder and harder for Americans to age with dignity and comfort. And yet my opponent, Rick Scott, wrote the plan that would end Medicare and Social Security. He's done nothing to improve the lives of Floridian seniors like my mom. Instead, he wants to cut valuable programs or privatize them.

Well, Rick Scott — and every other Republican who stands in the way of any American's good, stable retirement, have been given their notice. Today, my family and I are voting to retire Rick Scott for good.
