clean_body: Well, this Sunday — today — just got a whole lot more meaningful. | | | Friend — Sundays are always special in my household because of my mom. We usually spend the afternoon playing dominoes together. It's a simple but special Sunday tradition that has brought so much meaning to my life. Well, this Sunday — today — just got a whole lot more meaningful. Today my mom and I are voting early, where we will cast our ballots to elect me as Florida's next U.S. Senator and retire extremist Rick Scott for good. We'll also be joined by my husband, Robert, my sisters, and my kids. 🩷 With just 9 days left of this election, polls show me tied with Rick Scott and on the cusp of pulling off one of the greatest political upsets in history. I owe this moment, and just about everything in my life, to my mom. You see, my mom, sisters, and I lived under a dictatorship in Ecuador. It was my mom who made the brave decision to move us to America, knowing that if she worked hard, then she could give her kids equal opportunity to succeed and build their own American dream. She was right. But it wasn't easy. My mom had to start all over in a new country where she didn't know the language. She worked double shifts just to pay rent for a one room apartment while taking English lessons in the evening and on weekends. Despite the difficulties, my mom never wavered. It's my mom's constant reassurance, work ethic, and firm belief in the American dream that inspired me to fight for a better life — and inspired me to run for U.S. Senate. My mom's sacrifices enabled us to live out our own American dream. Now, it's both a privilege and joy to be my mom's caretaker, ensuring she can age with dignity and comfort. In fact, my ability to give my mom a good retirement is one of the things that I am most grateful for. It's not easy by any means, but I know all too well just how lucky my mom and I are. These days, it's getting harder and harder for Americans to age with dignity and comfort. And yet my opponent, Rick Scott, wrote the plan that would end Medicare and Social Security. He's done nothing to improve the lives of Floridian seniors like my mom. Instead, he wants to cut valuable programs or privatize them. Well, Rick Scott — and every other Republican who stands in the way of any American's good, stable retirement, have been given their notice. Today, my family and I are voting to retire Rick Scott for good. **Knock, knock, knock.**

_It’s the scariest sound you’ll hear when you live in a communist country._

_It’s the last sound my parents heard when their fathers were taken away._

_It’s the sound of always living in fear, and it’s my family’s real-life story._

We escaped from Vietnam just days before Saigon fell to the communists, and we were given a new life in the most generous country on Earth.

**America saved my life, and I dedicated my life to paying her back.**

I graduated from the United States Naval Academy and served for 25 years in Navy Special Operations in Iraq, Afghanistan, Somalia, and Pakistan and 40 other countries around the world.

I love this country - but right now, it’s taken a dark turn.

Now, the knocks are coming from Joe Biden’s Department of Justice. Sending two dozen armed agents to arrest a pro-life activist in front of his family. Raiding gun shops and seizing records from law-abiding gun owners. Arresting his challenger in the next election.

_And he’s doing it all while real criminals are free to roam our streets._

We are losing our country. You know it. But you also know we can save it.

I’ve been all over the world. Believe me when I tell you, if America fails, there is nowhere else to go.

**It’s time to save America while we still have a chance.**

**I’m Hung Cao, retired Navy Captain, and I’m running for the United States Senate.**

#
---
| | Hi Peter, Welcome to my team’s monthly newsletter of what I’ve been up to this month, so you can be in the loop about the great work happening. I know life can be busy, and your inbox can get filled up with political emails, so I appreciate any time you can dedicate to reading this newsletter each month. Thanks! — TK
---
* * *
**Oregon is voting!**
Ballots have been mailed to all Oregon registered voters. Please participate in your democracy and cast your vote this year! You can check the status of your ballot or find a drop-off site [here.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/95942039/508390336/-206629230?lang=en&refcode=AU_TK_CL_GEN_GEN_AC_20241027_PM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MjY1NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3Mjk2NTM0OS04Nzk0LWVmMTEtODhjZS0wMDBkM2E5OGZhNmIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=jUxqxMY1Kil0J6dk0WiGMYa3mRsl539PFfhJRFFVEvA=&emci=38741157-7294-ef11-88ce-000d3a98fa6b&emdi=72965349-8794-ef11-88ce-000d3a98fa6b&ceid=15353729)
* * *
**Governor Kotek thanks families and encourages school attendance.**
School attendance is a powerful predictor of student outcomes. Governor Kotek recently joined a phone bank with educators in Salem-Keizer School District to spread the word. She will do everything possible to make sure students show up to school.

Team — When I first swore my oath of office as an Assistant U.S. Attorney, I vowed to defend our country from threats both foreign and domestic.

But never did I expect to be called an enemy of our country — **but that’s what Donald Trump just said about me.** [ ](https://act.fightforreform.org/go/55977?t=7&akid=22422%2E4449941%2EEmlIOA) **On _Fox News_ , Donald Trump said that I am more dangerous than our foreign adversaries in China and Russia. And the same is true of anyone who stands up to him.**

Because of my efforts to defend our Constitution and hold Trump accountable, he considers me a threat.

And for a candidate who promises to be a “dictator on day one,” who is to say how he will seek retribution against me.

Donald Trump is a petty, vindictive man. And he must come nowhere near the Oval Office ever again.

_Trump also suggested that as president, he would send the National Guard after those enemies. Namely me._ [**As Donald Trump ramps up his attacks on me, I need the resources to respond right away. Voters across California are casting their ballots, and my GOP opponent Steve Garvey will benefit from increasing MAGA energy. Team, can you rush in a split contribution between Fight for Reform to help elect state and local Democrats and my campaign to make sure Californians know the truth about me and send me to the United States Senate?**](https://act.fightforreform.org/go/55977?t=8&akid=22422%2E4449941%2EEmlIOA) If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your split donation between Fight for Reform and Adam Schiff will go through immediately: | [CONTRIBUTE $10 »](https://act.fightforreform.org/go/55978?t=9&akid=22422%2E4449941%2EEmlIOA)

Team, our next commander-in-chief needs to be a strong ally to democracies across the country. They will need to work with leaders across the world to stand up to autocrats.

_Donald Trump is not that leader._ He reveres autocrats like Vladimir Putin. The hypocrisy of Trump calling me an enemy from within is astounding.

_Trump_ is the leader who sought foreign assistance to rig our elections.

_Trump_ is the leader who casts doubts on our electoral process and undermines our democracy.

_Trump_ is the leader who provoked a horrific insurrection on the United States Capitol, instigating a mob that threatened the lives of our lawmakers, our law enforcement, and his own vice president.

_Trump_ is the leader who wants to send the military after his political opponents.

But I suspect you don’t need to read another email detailing all the reasons campaign donations are so helpful right now. To be succinct about it, the race is extremely close, and more donations give us a better shot at winning.
Instead, I want to talk with you a bit about what this is all for, and why I’m so determined to win this fight — because it’s not about winning just for winning’s sake. It’s about what we can accomplish together if we’re successful next Tuesday.
**This election will determine whether families have access to quality, affordable healthcare.** Far-right Republicans are pushing to dismantle the Affordable Care Act, which would strip protections from millions of people with pre-existing conditions.
But I believe we need to _expand_ access to health care, not take it away. That’s why, here in Oregon, I introduced and passed legislation to hold Big Pharma accountable and lower prescription drug prices.
**This election will determine the kind of economic future families in this country can look forward to.** The MAGA agenda calls for more and more giveaways to corporations and special interests — but I think it’s long past time that we put working families first.
**This election will also determine the future of abortion rights.** Right now, 1 in 3 women live in states without access to abortion, and my opponent has supported an all-out abortion ban.
I have always stood, and will always stand, for abortion rights, period. I won’t stop fighting until we restore the right to choose in all 50 states.
**And then there’s the stakes of this election when it comes to our democracy.**
My opponent has said he supports Donald Trump’s decision making — even after he attempted to **overturn the 2020 election results**.
I will support the outcome of our nation’s free and fair elections — win or lose, **because it’s the right thing to do**.

body:
| Peter, is there *anything* I could say to convince you to pitch in to my campaign ahead of our fundraising deadline at midnight?

What if I told you that _**we’re just 9 days away from Election Day**_ , when the final votes will be cast and tallied in our critical Senate race?

Voter Action Project Logo [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-weekly?refcode=102724_1&amount=25]
NYT: Texas Attorney General Sues to Stop Voter Registration Push in San Antonio [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=102724_1&amount=25]
Texas is truly the new capital of voter suppression, Team.
Texas A.G. Ken Paxton sued Travis County ( Austin ) and Bexar County ( San Antonio ) over their plans to try and register unregistered voters. The suits seek to stop officials in both counties from mailing voter registration applications to non-registered residents of those counties.
Paxton claims he's not done, either, and has threatened Harris County ( Houston ) by letter as they consider similar measures to increase voter participation.
Of course, these lawsuits come on the heels of the Governor announcing that Texans has purged over 1 million voters the last few years. These purges disenfranchise legitimate registered voters and these lawsuits seek to stop new voters from getting registered. It's legalized voter suppression, right in our faces.
We have to fight voter suppression in Texas, Team, and in other states where opponents of voting rights resort to these extreme measures. Chip in $25 or whatever you can today to defend voting rights across the country >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=102724_1&amount=25]

| **ABOUT NELLA**
**New Mexico is Nella Domenici’s home. She was born in Albuquerque and lived for most of her childhood in a home near the intersection of Lomas and Monroe with her seven siblings, and her parents - Pete and Nancy Domenici. Nella began her education at Our Lady of Fatima, where she learned the values she holds today. Nella is a proud third-generation New Mexican, devoted mother of two, step-mom of four, and the wife of a Navy Veteran. Nella’s family’s roots run deep in New Mexico and she and her husband Pat enjoy their family home in New Mexico that they have owned for nearly twenty years.

Like most New Mexicans, Nella Domenici understands the importance of hard work. She waited tables to help pay for her undergraduate degree from Georgetown University, and worked her way through night school at Georgetown Law while holding down a full time job. She then graduated from Harvard Business School as a Baker Scholar, top 5% of the class, while 9 months pregnant.

Nella began her career at the bottom and worked her way up through the complex finance world, eventually serving as CFO for one of the world’s largest, most successful investment firms. In her career, Nella advised, invested in, grew, and led many companies, and served on public company boards. The industries she has worked in are vast and include areas such as health care, AI, food service, lodging, commercial real estate, mortgage lending, and consumer products. These companies have ranged from small family-owned businesses, to rapidly growing venture backed enterprises, to a Fortune 200 company. Several of these have been headquartered in New Mexico. Collectively, the companies Nella has been heavily involved with have employed thousands of Americans.

Like her father and mother, Nella has been a warrior for those who most need an advocate: for women competing in academics or business, for families dealing with mental illness, and for those without access to quality healthcare or education. **

Peter,

I have had the privilege of working behind the scenes in some of the most pivotal political campaigns in recent history. Today, I am reaching out to you on behalf of **Nella Domenici** , who is running for the United States Senate to represent New Mexico.

**Nella is a leader with a vision for a better America.** As a former business executive and the daughter of a long-term former U.S. Senator, Pete Domenici, she brings unparalleled experience and a deep commitment to serving the people of New Mexico.

**New Mexico is Nella Domenici’s home. Nella began her education at Our Lady of Fatima, where she learned the values she holds today. Nella is a proud third-generation New Mexican, devoted mother of two, step-mom of four, and the wife of a Navy Veteran. Nella’s family’s roots run deep in New Mexico and she and her husband Pat enjoy their family home in New Mexico that they have owned for nearly twenty years.

Like most New Mexicans, Nella Domenici understands the importance of hard work. She waited tables to help pay for her undergraduate degree from Georgetown University, and worked her way through night school at Georgetown Law while holding down a full time job. In her career, Nella advised, invested in, grew, and led many companies, and served on public company boards. The industries she has worked in are vast and include areas such as health care, AI, food service, lodging, commercial real estate, mortgage lending, and consumer products. Fellow American,

Why are you hearing from me?

**Well, I was raised in New Jersey. I love this state._And I love this country._**

[**I would like you to check out what Curtis Bashaw has to say, and if you agree with him, join me in supporting him in his bid for the US Senate.**](http://links.freedomfirstalert.com/u/click?_t=9ca143e971904d26a973d002cb0ae7f7&_m=e72cabb38ae84d19a43804b37d29ab1e&_e=Qs6Lwfu60g63EbbqM9tYIPYbIHuU2-34yJJ9QZMV7fVvXaG3GzUfAZtULJFWpSyUGw8LvEkbeR2zAJZOAqvXd07XVq8SfULygSyN23vs-hNFxtCOdltGqo9ZN9Xj7AHVk6sh1jnRAlbejddUfcJKFL26VqRWp0G5NFh9lRIvtPphV3WQhI1yBNP5ym2LX5OjyUtetyJaKgF0HL9cXDChVp9IzZYD_MEMUpcE3RSN3D3cDWVAL_udcr7JznX8ZlI16zgYaHiZBHp0MRGJITvpEzYhlUIkE1qZ13X-rMzSHfpdpWDM-soLgNG_cA6_Xt0wT7Yz4SF957qmPqsUy5PbZy7zKQKRYRBRceGaIRZTOSLstrQRXJkVwogI2ZIUWOfaxx3FMCxX21grw-Eo49Q6dclehfl3CFO_ETgPch2ZX9Q%3D)

I have been a known conservative in Hollywood throughout my career. It wasn’t always easy, but the latest from the bankrupt elites in my town really got to me.

After President Trump was shot, the only echo reverberating through my so-called “community” was a regret that the assassin failed to kill him. Weeks later, on a zoom call: White Dudes for Kamala. In a masterpiece of intolerance, in a breathtakingly short period of time, we learned what they are all about: _Hatred and Racism._ **Pathetic**.

I refuse to rail about the Democrats and what they have inflicted upon this country. We all know about their shortcomings, and we all know the kind of future we can bank on should they remain in power.

[**I believe Curtis Bashaw is the right kind of man to send to Washington to promote well-being in New Jersey and the United States at large. We can look to him to protect the Jersey Shore.**](http://links.freedomfirstalert.com/u/click?_t=9ca143e971904d26a973d002cb0ae7f7&_m=e72cabb38ae84d19a43804b37d29ab1e&_e=Qs6Lwfu60g63EbbqM9tYIPYbIHuU2-34yJJ9QZMV7fVvXaG3GzUfAZtULJFWpSyUGw8LvEkbeR2zAJZOAqvXd07XVq8SfULygSyN23vs-hNFxtCOdltGqo9ZN9Xj7AHVk6sh1jnRAlbejddUfcJKFL26VqRWp0G5NFh9lRIvtPphV3WQhI1yBNP5ym2LX5OjyUtetyJaKgF0HL9cXDChVp9IzZYD_MEMUpcE3RSN3D3cDWVAL_udcr7JznX8ZlI16zgYaHiZBHp0MRGJITvpE8rfmboOSgLHqiUHQM1owK2NtySBg17OXfyKNOq5-nZyEh5bO5O1YQ3Bv0I2o2OLTBHqPfBXaA9dCvTDgUIDsaZ-_VvlZHh7G0YocyfCjV6xOZDJZy9BQ7tm2iQTjQsi5-bkBi9NgHkhaaVI9R6KY0U%3D)

We can look to him to promote prosperity for all—a good paycheck and food we can afford. But more importantly, he is a good man. A man of good character. A man whose voice can be trusted as he raises his hand to preserve the Constitution of the United States. Our Constitution.

I truly appreciate all you've done to support my campaign. But I still need help- _this race is still too close!_ **Why is my race so close?** Unfortunately, one reason is that my opponent Colin Allred is untruthful, and is attempting to hide his radical liberal views from Texas voters. body:
We have many ways to win - and every vote is a win.

| | | [ ](https://www.jillstein2024.com/?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=how_we_win&n=1)
---
Peter,

Don't let anyone else tell you what our campaign is setting out to accomplish. We have many ways to win, and every vote is a win that helps to achieve our goals in this election, including winning the White House, growing the Green Party, and building power for a new kind of politics for people, planet, and peace. [**Take a look at our goals and how we win in 2024 and beyond:**](https://www.jillstein2024.com/goals?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=how_we_win&n=2)
---
[ ](https://www.jillstein2024.com/goals?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=how_we_win&n=3)
---
### **Top Goal:**
### **Turn the White House Green**
Through our prolific ballot access efforts, the Stein/Ware campaign is eligible for **508 Electoral Votes -** and we only need 270 to win. That means you can use your vote to vote for what you actually want and put President Jill Stein into the White House this election.
### **National Goal:**
### **5% of the Popular Vote for Public Funding**
By earning at least 5% of the national popular vote this November, the Green Party will be eligible [for millions of dollars in public funds for the 2028 General Election](https://jillsteinforpresident.nationbuilder.com/r?u=wnJj8Ho3UIzoIQ4-rbB9LAWbVH6WT5IwdPaXWVBUkuszUfztpCQKVmcPtdyd9a5-ZROShzVgJacj7g0QA9mqyNtZPTCBYuBsJatcCHpm42A8-XY6Hd-jbAvGIBenF4TVMKoPyb9SWd6Q3hDTzTU0LmfuEmqMkpgU50xoLDQUUGVe7MROFtsSkcMTFjnaF93HnSJBSwQnjNAPthTlu7Nm4w&e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=how_we_win&n=4). This would be an absolute game-changer and a major challenge to the broken two-party system.
### **State Goals:**
### **Maintain Our Ballot Access**
Ballot access is an incredibly large lift for candidates outside the two-party system, because Democrats and Republicans have designed restrictive, anti-democratic ballot access hurdles to protect themselves from competition. We are very proud to have overcome these hurdles to earn ballot access in most states, and the results of this election can also help us in future races. By earning at least a certain percentage in many states — some as low as 0.5%, many in the 1-2% range— we can ensure ballot access for state Green Parties in future elections, making it much easier to run more Green campaigns in the years to come.
### **Issues Goal:**
### **Win the Debate**
Our agenda for people, planet, and peace is extremely popular with voters, but many of these critical issues and solutions are never even discussed by the establishment parties. For decades, Greens have led the way on countless issues, including single-payer healthcare, marriage equality, justice for Palestine, ranked-choice voting, marijuana legalization, reparations, the Green New Deal, canceling student debt, and more. With every voter who hears our message and every vote we get in November, we are gaining traction for the winning ideas in [our platform](https://www.jillstein2024.com/platform?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=how_we_win&n=5) and building demand for the policies we need!
### **Organization Goal:**
### **Build the Green Party**
Polls have shown for years that a large majority of Americans believe we need a new major party because the establishment parties don’t represent the people. Our campaign is building the Green Party as a vehicle to challenge the failed two-party system and achieve the change we want to see in the world. By gaining ballot access across the country, building support for Green values and positions, and recruiting people into the Green movement, we are growing a sustainable political force that can change U.S. politics for good. While the political establishment has destroyed or co-opted many other political parties and movements, for decades the Green Party has survived to continue fighting, with many wins along the way. Greens have long been an integral part of many people’s movements and have won more than 1,500 elections, making the Green Party the largest and most successful independent party in the U.S. that doesn’t take money from corporate interests. By channeling the energy of this campaign into building the Green Party movement, we are working towards getting more Green candidates into elected office and turning our vision of a better world into a reality. Our message is resonating because we are not bought by special interests like Wall Street, fossil fuels, and the military industrial complex, freeing us to speak about the real change that Americans need. If you're ready to break free from corporate-controlled politics, join us and [**Vote for Jill Stein**!](https://jillsteinforpresident.nationbuilder.com/r?u=oFDRNpCTC3QvtvB7QRs8lp6lmJQhnbYrq4oV2EGqUg4&e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=how_we_win&n=6) clean_body: We have many ways to win - and every vote is a win. | | | Peter, Don't let anyone else tell you what our campaign is setting out to accomplish. We have many ways to win, and every vote is a win that helps to achieve our goals in this election, including winning the White House, growing the Green Party, and building power for a new kind of politics for people, planet, and peace. Top Goal: Turn the White House Green Through our prolific ballot access efforts, the Stein/Ware campaign is eligible for 508 Electoral Votes - and we only need 270 to win. That means you can use your vote to vote for what you actually want and put President Jill Stein into the White House this election. National Goal: 5% of the Popular Vote for Public Funding By earning at least 5% of the national popular vote this November, the Green Party will be eligible . This would be an absolute game-changer and a major challenge to the broken two-party system. State Goals: Maintain Our Ballot Access Ballot access is an incredibly large lift for candidates outside the two-party system, because Democrats and Republicans have designed restrictive, anti-democratic ballot access hurdles to protect themselves from competition. We are very proud to have overcome these hurdles to earn ballot access in most states, and the results of this election can also help us in future races. By earning at least a certain percentage in many states — some as low as 0.5%, many in the 1-2% range— we can ensure ballot access for state Green Parties in future elections, making it much easier to run more Green campaigns in the years to come. Issues Goal: Win the Debate Our agenda for people, planet, and peace is extremely popular with voters, but many of these critical issues and solutions are never even discussed by the establishment parties. For decades, Greens have led the way on countless issues, including single-payer healthcare, marriage equality, justice for Palestine, ranked-choice voting, marijuana legalization, reparations, the Green New Deal, canceling student debt, and more. With every voter who hears our message and every vote we get in November, we are gaining traction for the winning ideas in and building demand for the policies we need! Organization Goal: Build the Green Party Polls have shown for years that a large majority of Americans believe we need a new major party because the establishment parties don’t represent the people. Our campaign is building the Green Party as a vehicle to challenge the failed two-party system and achieve the change we want to see in the world. By gaining ballot access across the country, building support for Green values and positions, and recruiting people into the Green movement, we are growing a sustainable political force that can change U.S. politics for good. While the political establishment has destroyed or co-opted many other political parties and movements, for decades the Green Party has survived to continue fighting, with many wins along the way. Greens have long been an integral part of many people’s movements and have won more than 1,500 elections, making the Green Party the largest and most successful independent party in the U.S. that doesn’t take money from corporate interests. By channeling the energy of this campaign into building the Green Party movement, we are working towards getting more Green candidates into elected office and turning our vision of a better world into a reality. Our message is resonating because we are not bought by special interests like Wall Street, fossil fuels, and the military industrial complex, freeing us to speak about the real change that Americans need. Between the California Democratic Party, labor organizations, and countless endorsements by current and former elected officials, we’re sure Evan has what it takes to represent the diversity and determination of CA-16. = | = | = | = | = | = Thanks, Team Low | | = Paid for by Evan Low for Congress Evan Low for Congress 1700 Tribute Road, Suite 201 Sacramento, CA 95815 United States | = = | | Throughout his time in public service, Evan has defended our most vulnerable and built coalitions to deliver solutions. Now, he's running for Congress at an inflection point for Silicon Valley and the nation. Our region needs a representative who will lead on maintaining our global competitiveness, combat hate, stand up for the vulnerable, protect reproductive freedom, reduce crime in our communities, and ensure the middle class can once again afford to buy a house and raise a family where they work. Together, we will usher in a new era of courageous leadership for Silicon Valley. =**

body:

Our launch day.
The day Kari Lake launched her campaign.
The day Kyrsten Sinema decided not to run for re-election.
The day we won our primary.
The day Ruben addressed the Convention.

If you’re been waiting for the best time to support Sarah, this is it.
#
The countdown is on:
**There are just four days left until our final major fundraising deadline before Election Day** , and everything we raise before midnight on Thursday, October 31st will infuse our campaign with last-minute resources to go all out to elect Sarah.
That’s why we set a goal to raise $25,000 in grassroots donations from emails like this one before next Thursday.
[**If you’re been waiting for the best time to support Sarah, this is it. Pitch in $5 to anything you can to support our historic campaign.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mcb-em-20241027-1?refcode=em20241027-1490&amount=5&refcode2=1490_21716_Q9Xnp_&akid=1490%2E21716%2EQ9Xnp_)
**Our polling shows that there are _a lot_ of undecided voters left**, which means we really need the funding to put out all the stops and get Sarah’s closing message in front of voters before our last weekend of GOTV.
We ran the numbers, and if we raise $25,000 in email contributions by Thursday, we can put in the extra dollars we need to boost our digital ad spending, send more texts, put up more yard signs, and send more volunteers on the road to knock doors for Sarah.
_But we can only do it if we reach our goal._
[**So we’re asking, can you pitch in anything you can spare toward our $25,000 October fundraising goal? Peter, We're in a moment of national reflection. And for many Americans, it's a question of how we reset and reshape our culture, institutions, and daily lives--_for the better_. **Peter, over the past year, I wrote my new book, ****_Right Wing Revolution,_****as a guide for a return to an America where ...**
* We are united with a national spirit of love of country and belief in American Greatness.

* We have a free society, secure borders, and respect for our Constitution.

* We have rapidly increasing church attendance and a nationwide spiritual renewal.

* We trust our neighbors, feel safe in our communities, and don't have to lock our doors at night.

* We bring up the next generation to love our country, to live with integrity and strong morals, and to champion a bright future for all Americans.

_[**Can I send you a FREE copy of**** _Right Wing Revolution_****to read today? All I ask for in return is a gift of ANY amount to support Turning Point USA --and our critically important work to make kids LOVE AMERICA again.**](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=b7f331d63d034fc5b440c236f47abce6&_e=gyKHSnelexquBfWdOFR597MW-vVncPl0BnbBIG816E71iBdDGsj4N7niB-lTPUEfrQ-9aaBSSdEMJwFbKNac2NeaxMwezvIW02yEeRTyiGNmlPOiakqO7IOQrHCkjZde6jhL75N-Byoq_H_2NGx4lCOwHHz2u0zfPjvo4O7qWdX_JG5qGfGtD4XHOuKn_SdtZuqrcZ6PgX8_a2o3_DAoAKLPFstbqKHW1JXsb5ZywHVe0ot_MLy2314t0wG02ArPywIVnWXUTQ-xRkJMN_7Ae0TJEHA3Kayb7hEgFreLwKyD8nNFRPBgZk5Hc4FQQmWe)_
---
[**Make your gift & get your FREE book**](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=b7f331d63d034fc5b440c236f47abce6&_e=gyKHSnelexquBfWdOFR597MW-vVncPl0BnbBIG816E71iBdDGsj4N7niB-lTPUEfrQ-9aaBSSdEMJwFbKNac2NeaxMwezvIW02yEeRTyiGNmlPOiakqO7IOQrHCkjZde6jhL75N-Byoq_H_2NGx4lKvI0X--vbSea339vgAtFqX6A8kvTs5Irj4tVHwCzQFf24Sr6JUa9ibXyXz-bSRNpcGB6f5zDa7uIf0PiLc_OPMlHVK90D8AsY9EeRENbTekaTkNQdxtifcfNuThmvEzBnmPULT4vdsxKx4APMvucekt_zjfVE34QRNzdUf3SwMz)
---
Peter, I'm proud to say that _Right Wing Revolution_ is like NO OTHER book you've read from the Right before:
* It's NOT a history of political tactics and the back-and-forth between Left and Right.

The Project 2025 deregulation agenda would gut clean water and air protections leaving communities vulnerable to dangerous environmental toxins. Donald Trump was in Michigan yesterday and used his rally as yet another moment to attack me, saying I “don’t have what it takes.”
Friend, we have just 9 days until the election, and I need your help to fight back. Please use this link to donate now:

**Knock, knock, knock.**

_It’s the scariest sound you’ll hear when you live in a communist country._

_It’s the last sound my parents heard when their fathers were taken away._

_It’s the sound of always living in fear, and it’s my family’s real-life story._

We escaped from Vietnam just days before Saigon fell to the communists, and we were given a new life in the most generous country on Earth.

**America saved my life, and I dedicated my life to paying her back.**

I graduated from the United States Naval Academy and served for 25 years in Navy Special Operations in Iraq, Afghanistan, Somalia, and Pakistan and 40 other countries around the world.

I love this country - but right now, it’s taken a dark turn.

Now, the knocks are coming from Joe Biden’s Department of Justice. Sending two dozen armed agents to arrest a pro-life activist in front of his family. Raiding gun shops and seizing records from law-abiding gun owners. Arresting his challenger in the next election.

_And he’s doing it all while real criminals are free to roam our streets._

We are losing our country. You know it. But you also know we can save it.

I’ve been all over the world. Believe me when I tell you, if America fails, there is nowhere else to go.

**It’s time to save America while we still have a chance.**

**I’m Hung Cao, retired Navy Captain, and I’m running for the United States Senate.**

**[If you’re all-in to defend the greatest country on Earth, join our team today.](http://links.freedomfirstalert.com/u/click?_t=9ca143e971904d26a973d002cb0ae7f7&_m=bcd8b0ab66ef4d64836293fe926f84ff&_e=FeeIN0w0dh-4FHxlq1-6EU1oh6Xqbb26HzDS4hIinoEcxJkvlN0gMLIRVFB1WpvflgnK78KepG_CkWDXcGFTaZMOffOg46ML4u94SHBugsugcVvwSR5vTclbwJaXdiY5OMFliktRSkQkP7cvmVoBhygesJYcrPIMD1nujfwTMk-bUMuAGZ_-GPKGlBu3rnGxxyY80__eKdMXEmRtUuOSHWu4lG-82KkVgpTzntSrHAx7WBWpj80ClMKxBrbK0nx4WYe6M_O9i9kfJEs8rtDgo47xdIwuJnGQmLRU0Sxbyq8TmyEmpUiwCl76Um9LEQOioyo7kBTMOYieTTjsFrewIQ-E1ZZtAZ_HQoFxpRjDvOvPx1itSRm1biMyMaGxUwLt)**
---
[**JOIN THE TEAM - STAND WITH ME TODAY**](http://links.freedomfirstalert.com/u/click?_t=9ca143e971904d26a973d002cb0ae7f7&_m=bcd8b0ab66ef4d64836293fe926f84ff&_e=FeeIN0w0dh-4FHxlq1-6EU1oh6Xqbb26HzDS4hIinoEcxJkvlN0gMLIRVFB1WpvflgnK78KepG_CkWDXcGFTaZMOffOg46ML4u94SHBugsugcVvwSR5vTclbwJaXdiY5OMFliktRSkQkP7cvmVoBhygesJYcrPIMD1nujfwTMk-bUMuAGZ_-GPKGlBu3rnGxxyY80__eKdMXEmRtUuOSHWu4lG-82KkVgpTzntSrHAxVDSFnpXF0ScFoFwQXG0Onj6Udt7r8xY9P5ul4kw_eQb8CIQ9gRcDJeVDpvLGUB7zP4caHhf2PHr5sU8kHzWZqzQWlhQN-mt5MqFZyqWb3ScUrEfXwhJLLmJIScMyKn6ZcXSrVaSYNn5HQzkdb2os5)
---
I still believe America can be the land of opportunity, Fellow Patriot.

And as someone who owes their life to the American Dream, I have an obligation to fight back against those who have trampled on it.

We need REAL fighters. Not politicians, not bureaucrats, and not keyboard warriors acting tough in custom made suits.

clean_body: | | | Knock, knock, knock. It’s the scariest sound you’ll hear when you live in a communist country. It’s the last sound my parents heard when their fathers were taken away. It’s the sound of always living in fear, and it’s my family’s real-life story. We escaped from Vietnam just days before Saigon fell to the communists, and we were given a new life in the most generous country on Earth. America saved my life, and I dedicated my life to paying her back. I graduated from the United States Naval Academy and served for 25 years in Navy Special Operations in Iraq, Afghanistan, Somalia, and Pakistan and 40 other countries around the world. I love this country - but right now, it’s taken a dark turn. Now, the knocks are coming from Joe Biden’s Department of Justice. Sending two dozen armed agents to arrest a pro-life activist in front of his family. Raiding gun shops and seizing records from law-abiding gun owners. Arresting his challenger in the next election. And he’s doing it all while real criminals are free to roam our streets. We are losing our country. You know it. But you also know we can save it. I’ve been all over the world. Believe me when I tell you, if America fails, there is nowhere else to go. It’s time to save America while we still have a chance. I’m Hung Cao, retired Navy Captain, and I’m running for the United States Senate. I still believe America can be the land of opportunity, Fellow Patriot. And as someone who owes their life to the American Dream, I have an obligation to fight back against those who have trampled on it. We need REAL fighters. Not politicians, not bureaucrats, and not keyboard warriors acting tough in custom made suits. If we’re going to preserve our freedoms, we can’t be intimidated. We must be fearless. Let’s win this. name: Tammy Baldwin
subject: Making a difference.
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY TAMMY BALDWIN FOR SENATE
body:
[ https://act.tammybaldwin.com/go/67?t=1001&akid=4308%2E35263%2EMaJiHc ]TAMMY BALDWIN FOR SENATE

Peter — In a
moment, [ https://act.tammybaldwin.com/go/2155?c0=tbe-em-oct24.yPYsfQ&refcode=AU_STB_FR_GEN_GEN_AC_20241027_AM1_V1_S1&t=1004&akid=4308%2E35263%2EMaJiHc ]I’ll ask you to make a donation to help me win my most
competitive reelection yet. But first, I want to tell you more about how I
got here.

When I came out in college, I knew that I wanted to pursue a career in
public service. But I feared that I would have to face a serious choice
between pursuing the field of my dreams or living my authentic life
openly.

Seeing others in the LGBTQ+ community demonstrate acts of courage by
coming out, celebrating who they are, and being proud about who they love
helped me realize that I could do both. I could both run for office and be
honest about who I am.

So thanks to the support of this remarkable team, I was elected as the
first openly gay Senator in our nation’s history. But I didn’t run for
office to make history,
Peter — I ran to make a
difference.

I knew that I needed to use this extraordinary opportunity to make a
difference in people's lives. Folks like you supported me because you
wanted to make a difference, too. And together, we’ve made incredible
progress — but our work isn’t over yet.

name: Ernest Lineberger
subject: Update from Lineberger for US Congress – October 27th, 2024
body:
Hi Friends of Lineberger for US Congress!

First, the big news!

Last week we told you that we were recommended by the Dallas Morning News!
Later we learned that we were *also endorsed by the Fort Worth
Star-Telegram*! This is huge! This is the kind of thing that is worthy of
a mention when people ask about my campaign. Their words include:

“The district, which covers much of Denton and Wise counties, deserves a
successor to Burgess who has a chance to develop into an effective
legislator. Only Democrat Ernest R. Lineberger III fits the description.”

Link to article:
https://www.star-telegram.com/opinion/election-recommendations/article294133934.html

This week we also have an ad placed in the local paper for Muenster and
Linday in Cooke County.

Starting October 21st, I have been at the Carrollton Public Library at
Hebron and Josey poll greeting. I bring a canopy, chairs, table, signs,
and more. I greet voters as they head to vote, saying “Hi! As you go
vote, my name will be on your ballot as the Democratic Nominee for US House
of Representatives. Your Better Choice for a Better Future.” The response
varies greatly, but a lot (did I say ‘a lot’) of people come out and give
me a thumbs up or say “I voted for you”. There is no way to know our
percentage even at this one polling location, but it seems like it isn’t
zero. To be fair, ‘a lot’ of people also go over to the Trump tent to
celebrate. And once in a while, someone will do both... go figure. Early
voting continues Monday – Friday, 7 am - 7 pm. It’s a beating, but I’m
committed to keep poll greeting. November 5th is election day! Also, 7 to
7.
*Make sure you and your circle have your plan to vote!*

*https://www.votedenton.gov/* <https://www.votedenton.gov/>

* or You can type ‘votedenton.gov <http://votedenton.gov>’ to get to the
website. To see your sample ballot (Print it, and bring it in for
a reference) To see voting locations, 54 early voting locations
in Denton County If you wait for November 5th, you
must vote only at you allocated location (check this website)*

*All of my recommended candidates have DEM after their name**. It is as
easy as that.*

*Our Digital Ads continue to run on a variety of media to get my name
around the district.*

*We put extra money into texting and digital ads to help convince
persuadable voters to vote for me.*

*Our postcards are winding their way through the mail and into the hearts
and minds of persuadable voters. I had one man stop his car (as I
was poll greeting) and tell me that he only heard about me because of a
letter they just got in the mail (probably a postcard). He checked out my
campaign and decided to vote for me!!! It all helps.*

*If you would like to help, poll greeting is great. Just go to your
nearest polling location, bring one of my yard signs with you and sit or
stand just outside the 100-foot line. Be pleasant and show your support.
There are many ways to do it, but no wrong way as long as you are pleasant
and friendly (regardless of any provocation). Remember, some REP’s are
saying DEM’s are demons. We need to make sure we prove them wrong, not
right. So, be super polite. Many voters have said “Thank you for
being here!”. I think a clear democratic presence helps them to feel safer
when they have heard rumors of bad things going on. I even made little
signs to say “DEM” to help clarify party. I can tell you that the REP poll
greeters at my site have been sweet and friendly. We have had no issues.
We even support each other when there is a need. *

*Shirts**; We still have some Lineberger light blue T-shirts left. Perfect
for Poll Greeters, Door knockers, etc. Inventory now is S - 2, L – 10, XL
– 5. No charge, just wear with pride and share the message.*

*Signs, Signs, Signs**; Signs at the polling location! Thanks to everyone
who participated in this effort. *

*I have a few signs left, but not more than 10. Let me know if you need
signs – OR IF YOU HAVE EXTRA SIGNS. If they aren’t where they can be seen,
it’s time to put them out. *

*Social media Support needed sharing the message*; Share – Share –
Share!!! Liking and commenting is good, but it doesn’t add more people to
the post like sharing. You don’t have to wait for a new post. Go find an
old one you liked and share that to your circle of influence. Maybe the
one about being recommended by The Dallas Morning News!

Here is what’s coming up soon, plus major events up to the election.

*Monday, Oct 28th*, 7 am, Early Voting continues!!! - *Poll Greeting
daily (help is welcome to staff the major polling sites) – If you poll
greet, send us a pic of you out there.*

*TBD Monday, Oct 28th*, NewsRadio 1080 KRLD wanted a short interview over
the phone

*Thursday, Oct 31st*, Halloween

*Friday, Nov 1st*, 7 pm, Early Voting Ends

*Saturday, Nov 2nd*, 11 am, Denton Women’s March – followed by block
walking/ phone banking TBD

*Sunday, Nov 3rd*, 3 am, Daylight Savings Time Ends – Fall Back (in bed for
one more hour of sleep)

*Tuesday, Nov 5th*, 7 am – 7 pm, Election Day – Poll Greeting (Will need
even more help with even more polling sites)

*Tuesday, Nov 5th*, Election Night Watch Party, Union Bear Brewing Company,
215 S Bell Ave, Denton
Mobilize link to sign up and details:
https://www.mobilize.us/dentondemocrats/event/670137/

*Wednesday, Nov 6th*, Begin Post Election Life – To Be Determined

*Saturday, Nov 9th*, 9 am, Speak at Little Elm Veterans Day Event
McCord Park, 1900 FM 423, Little Elm, TX

To donate, just go to the regular donation link on the campaign website,
https://www.linebergerforuscongress.com/.
Our Digital Ad campaign is alive and well on C-TV, Meta, YouTube and much
more. Plus, we are doing some amount of direct texting. Your
contributions at this point will be helping us to expand this program to
extend our reach to the many voters we were not able to touch in person.
It’s cost efficient and really reaching lots of people.

Everything you do to support us in our efforts to get our message out,
support our campaign financially, and your own personal efforts to share
our message are making a difference. Thank you!

Giving Voters a Better Choice and Hope for a Better Future!

Ernest Lineberger

Your Democratic Nominee for US House for TX CD26.

I maintain my belief that each voter's voice should be heard, no matter how difficult the questions, or uncomfortable the answers.
Late last week, members of my team invited Elise Stefanik to a debate on Monday, October 28, 2024, at 6:30pm at The Crandall Library in Glens Falls. The invitation was served on a member of the Stefanik team in person at the Westport Amtrak Station, with a request that it would be delivered and discussed with the Congresswoman.
Unsurprisingly, Elise Stefanik has indicated that she will not be attending a debate with her Democratic opponent. Not now. Not ever. According to reporting by The Post Star, Stefanik Senior Advisor, Alex DeGrasse, stated that the "Downstate New York City Democrat doesn't qualify for any debate."
Instead of the debate that the voters deserve, we will gather for a discussion at The Crandall Library. If you have questions for Congresswoman Stefanik, we will provide paper and pens. I am firmly committed to getting the voices of the voters heard. My team will do their best to get your questions delivered to her.
After discussion and questions from the audience, my team will offer a screening of a film that depicts the journey of another Trump devotee, Lev Parnas. If you have not yet seen "From Russia with Lev" (or even if you have seen it and want to see it again!), please join us at 6:30pm, Monday, October 28, 2024, at The Crandall Library in Glens Falls.
Our democracy is based on the free exchange of ideas. In recent days, I have learned of voters who were called to participate in telephone surveys, only to have the caller hang up when they stated that they do not plan to vote for Elise Stefanik. I've learned of county executives who have had calls abruptly disconnected when they indicated they would not be endorsing Stefanik. I've heard of reporters getting limited or no access to the incumbent Representative. While Stefanik has appeared briefly in the district during this campaign cycle, the events were private events, with notice to press and the public given after the fact. And of course, this and any other attempt to hold a debate or a town hall style event has fallen flat, despite numerous invitations from my staff and from various media outlets.
We must continue our efforts to hold our elected officials accountable. In fact, it is our civic duty. Deeply ingrained in our identity as Americans is the idea that our elected officials speak with us regularly, listen to our opinions, and respond to our questions.
It is not acceptable that a candidate focus her campaign efforts at a location out-of-state, as Stefanik has done by setting up offices at the Trump Winery in Charlottesville, Virginia, as reported recently by North Country Public Radio (NCPR).
It is not acceptable that Stefanik would hold few or no public campaign events during an election cycle.
The voters deserve an opportunity to ask questions, and to get answers.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/90202ed5-f942-4603-8853-c76be348efe0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
I'm mindful of the words of Thomas Jefferson in the Declaration of Independence, when he wrote of "repeated injuries and usurpations" that led to our break with the prevailing government at the time. Said Jefferson, "He has combined with others to subject us to a jurisdiction foreign to our constitution, and unacknowledged by our laws; giving his Assent to their Acts of pretended Legislation..."
Elise Stefanik is no monarch, as Thomas Jefferson was describing.
Stefanik has, however, in some bizarre grab for power, "combined" herself with Donald Trump, the strongest advocate and exemplar for fascism ever to rise within the ranks of a major political party, to "subject us to a jurisdiction foreign to our constitution."
The voices and needs of the voters of New York's 21st Congressional District have been traded off in some grotesque drop-the-voters-of-your-congressional-district-to-come-and-campaign-for-me transaction with Donald Trump. That transaction might get Trump elected. It might get a new government position for Stefanik. It gets the voters of New York 21 nothing.
We need a climate change policy.
We need a border policy.
We need healthcare.
We need an economy that works for the middle class.
We need affordable housing.
We need broadband and wifi throughout the congressional district.
We need protection of healthcare rights.
We need protection of all people, regardless of race, creed, color, country of origin, disability, or pregnancy status.
Elise Stefanik, by her alignment with the 34-count felon Donald Trump, is engaging in "pretended" representation of NY-21.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/0889b77d-8c3f-484e-8dba-e63f500dbfb8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Elise Stefanik swore an oath to protect and defend the U.S. Constitution. She is campaigning for a candidate who plans to terminate portions of the Constitution. For that reason, she should resign from office immediately.
Elise Stefanik is not campaigning for a seat with the voters of NY-21. She is not even present in the district to do so. Instead, she is campaigning for a seat in a fascist-hopeful's future administration, refusing to disavow herself of that candidate when he issues vulgarities and crudeness about and towards women, when he calls veterans "suckers and losers", when he plans to pardon insurrectionists who beat and killed men and women in blue uniforms at the U.S. Capitol on January 6, 2021, calling the seditionists, "hostages". For all of these reasons, Stefanik should suspend her campaign for re-election immediately.
Early voting is in progress. Election Day is November 5, 2024.
The race for the midterms starts November 6, 2024. We're in this for the long haul.
_If we haven 't met yet, I am Paula Collins, the Democratic and Working Families Party Candidate for New York's 21st Congressional District. Your comments are invaluable to me. Please let me hear from you. Remember that you can always visit my website at www.paulacollinsforcongress.com or by sending me a text at 315-230-3920. _

name: Breaking News via Team Tester
subject: Tim Sheehy lied about his military service.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Defeat Boebert PAC
body:
| | | Peter—it’s Shelbi, Jon Tester’s Campaign Manager. I just made a tough decision that you need to hear about immediately. **According to several recent reports, Tim Sheehy lied about his military service.**
1. On the campaign trail, Sheehy claimed he had a gunshot wound in his arm from combat. But according to the **_New York Times_** , public records, and firsthand accounts—including a Navy SEAL who served with Sheehy—his gunshot wound was from accidentally shooting himself in the arm in Glacier National Park.
2. Days later, _**NBC News**_ released another bombshell report stating Sheehy lied about being “medically discharged” from the Navy.

We've already seen the popular vote loser win the White House five times, including twice in the last twenty years .

# **Over $16 Million to Fix Philadelphia School Buildings**
Senator Hughes was proud to announce over **$16 million dollars for Philadelphia public schools** to make repairs and improvements to school buildings. The funds will be used for projects to fix windows, doors, rooves, bathrooms, and a ventilation system.
## _Time to Fix Philadelphia's Toxic Schools_
Senator Hughes has been fighting for funding to fix Pennsylvania's toxic and crumbling schools for years. He has toured a number of schools and has seen firsthand the need for investments to make essential repairs and improvements to old school buildings that were very visibly falling apart.
* * *
**" I've toured schools in the city that have leaks, visible mold on the walls, and old, outdated heating and air conditioning equipment. Many of our schools have had to close because it was too hot for anyone to be in the building.** **This funding will alleviate a lot of those issues and provide healthier learning environments for our students, teachers, and school administrators. "**
* * *
## _The Job is Not Done_
__ Senator Hughes has been fighting to fix Pennsylvania's unconstitutional education funding system for over 10 years. Just this summer, he helped achieve a significant milestone for Pennsylvania's public education system with an increase of over $1 billion for Pre-K to 12 education funding. This investment was a historic downpayment to fix Pennsylvania's education funding system, but the job is not finished. He's continuing the work to bring more investments to support Pennsylvania students, teachers, and school administrators. name: Sara Jacobs
subject: How to stop the dangerous path Trump has put us on

body:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sjj-em [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sjj-em]
Friends, I get it: It can be hard to continue mustering the same shock and dismay at the things that just keep coming out about Donald Trump. It’s been going on for years.
But new reporting shows that Trump praised Hitler’s generals – “ I need the kind of generals that Hitler had. People who were totally loyal to him, that follow orders. ” It’s genuinely alarming in a way we need to talk about.
Trump has made it clear that he admires tyrants and dictators, in large part because they have militaries that are loyal to them personally – which it seems Trump would prefer over a military loyal to the U.S. Constitution.
He’s been very open about the fact that he wants that kind of unchecked power – “extreme power,” as he called it in one campaign event last week. He’s also been explicit about what he’d do with it:
He’d enact an economic plan that, according to dozens of Nobel Prize-winning economists, would raise prices, worsen inflation, and blow up the deficit.
He’d punish women who access basic reproductive health care, even when their doctors deem it medically necessary.
And of course, he’s said multiple times now that he would use the U.S. military to “take care of” the “enemy from within” – according to Trump, people like Adam Schiff and Nancy Pelosi.
This is not normal.
With a second term, Trump could do all of the above and so much more – unraveling the fabric of our basic institutions and eroding our democracy.
But in just 9 days, the American people have a say in whether he’s given that chance.
I’m not asking you for money in this email – I know that many of you already give whatever you can, whenever you can, to many campaigns and organizations. Instead, I’m just asking you to please , make sure you cast your ballot, and that your friends and family do the same.
If you need information about how, where, or when to vote, you can find that here at IWillVote.com. [https://iwillvote.com/]
If you’d like to volunteer with the Harris-Walz campaign, whether that’s making phone calls into presidential battleground states, traveling somewhere to canvass, or taking action virtually, you can sign up to do that right here. [https://go.kamalaharris.com/]
We have the power to defeat Donald Trump. We have the power to elect Kamala Harris and see a strong, principled, compassionate leader in the White House. We just need to take that power and use it.
Thanks for reading. I hope you’ll consider forwarding this message to any friends, family members, colleagues, or neighbors who need a reminder to go vote.
-Sara

# [Why Were Old Bridges Covered?](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sm1c0d&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com)

| C overed bridges are an idyllic symbol of rural America. Despite their dispensability in the age of concrete and steel, these old wooden bridges continue to be beloved landmarks, their distinct roofs making them easily recognizable even today. subject: I've made a lot of sacrifices.
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY TIM SCOTT FOR AMERICA
body:
There is not much time left to save this country. I’m willing to sacrifice everything for it because if we lose, there will be nothing left.

| |

| | | Friend,

There is not much time left to save this country. I'm willing to sacrifice everything for it because if we lose, there will be nothing left.

**[Will you make a small sacrifice of JUST $10?](http://links.freedomfirstalert.com/u/click?_t=9ca143e971904d26a973d002cb0ae7f7&_m=2bfe4e8ddcba4c0a8f4293979fa8bc78&_e=FIX1aWjDVTUTqq248z71SkDCwGvNhRpl2gFlQHerjpTqZxBW5ZbWeDvDElzul7ChRpPDSmVwZ3Ym6rX4EtBnbt5_xi1h8emaSAW4CqjhMdw-uxlhpGk7Bspe62VKMsGMLc1ATTXu_zpPbkxup2iwp5lPhb636mT8t39kuaoqPS_pzSCfi2Z6fyurIdtMdlALqp4BlGe94L2G5F8ga9utnhkUzDnXB-ndZGFFfli-qhtpsmDsM70U5gWaXjeEljo_0NixioCKHMOs2dKrt4cOePza_XJw92TI717AyNAkjY1oX8mchh4yJJyKxvcljf1qTLhOzgtHWZs3d7wgGvuZHrBU8rTOIzaMpNdwiy1cUu-XGFWyvO7BEMoYw8bD68gfZAY2QOSDXn3bt-hu73E1Hu9lloTIjiGvzJ6q3iJGZtCc7STzOnObIAaKSVCa1Fxr "Will you make a small sacrifice of JUST $10?")**

Running for Senate has been the hardest decision I've made in my entire life. I am just a normal mom. The disgusting things the media and establishment have done to me are unforgivable. If you had asked me a few years ago if I believed someone would come to my door and ask me to sell out my country for a pile of cash, I wouldn't have believed you.

**There 's so much I miss about my life before politics, and there's no shortage of sacrifices I've had to make. Much of them at the cost of my personal life. **

I gave up my career in the news media. I loved my job, but I refused to tell the lies that are now required of those working in mainstream media.

**I miss my family.** There's too little time to spend with my kiddos when I spend every day on the campaign trail. Thankfully, my husband, Jeff, is always by my side. However, I ran for Senate to protect my kids' future, and it hurts my heart that I can't see them as much as I'd like to.

**I miss waking up and enjoying just five minutes of sleep before my phone starts ringing.** Now I can't go a few hours without some fire drill needing to be put out.

**I miss not having to send these emails.** Finances have to be the worst part of running for Senate. Campaigning across Arizona costs more than I ever thought it would, but I'm committed to seeing this race through, even if it hurts my pride to ask you for help.

**I miss my alone time!** I never realized how much I took advantage of spending a few hours by myself. In this race, I'm often campaigning from dawn to dusk and, more often than not, early into the morning of the next day.

Friend, as much as I miss some of the comforts of day-to-day life, I know the sacrifices I'm making now will be worth it.

Now listen, there are less than two months before ballots start dropping in Arizona, and I need your help now more than ever. Recent polls show me tied to my opponent, Ruben Gallego, and every penny could push us over the edge and help secure victory.

Today, I'm asking you to make a sacrifice Friend. Will you stand with me and make a ONE TIME small-dollar contribution to my Senate campaign?

I'm willing to sacrifice everything for it because if we lose, there will be nothing left. "Will you make a small sacrifice of JUST $10?" Running for Senate has been the hardest decision I've made in my entire life. I am just a normal mom. The disgusting things the media and establishment have done to me are unforgivable. If you had asked me a few years ago if I believed someone would come to my door and ask me to sell out my country for a pile of cash, I wouldn't have believed you. There 's so much I miss about my life before politics, and there's no shortage of sacrifices I've had to make. Much of them at the cost of my personal life. I gave up my career in the news media. I loved my job, but I refused to tell the lies that are now required of those working in mainstream media. I miss my family. There's too little time to spend with my kiddos when I spend every day on the campaign trail. Thankfully, my husband, Jeff, is always by my side. However, I ran for Senate to protect my kids' future, and it hurts my heart that I can't see them as much as I'd like to. I miss waking up and enjoying just five minutes of sleep before my phone starts ringing. Now I can't go a few hours without some fire drill needing to be put out. I miss not having to send these emails. Finances have to be the worst part of running for Senate. Campaigning across Arizona costs more than I ever thought it would, but I'm committed to seeing this race through, even if it hurts my pride to ask you for help. I miss my alone time! I never realized how much I took advantage of spending a few hours by myself. In this race, I'm often campaigning from dawn to dusk and, more often than not, early into the morning of the next day. Friend, as much as I miss some of the comforts of day-to-day life, I know the sacrifices I'm making now will be worth it. Now listen, there are less than two months before ballots start dropping in Arizona, and I need your help now more than ever. DEMAND THE BAN
Ban Pharma Ads–
Sign the Petition
Dear Peter,
Pharmaceutical ads are endangering our health, inflating our medicine costs, and silencing the truth. [**_Sign the petition today_** to demand a ban on these harmful ads and protect our right to health and honesty.](https://www.mahanow.org/pharma-ads-petition?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=pharma_ad_petition_10_20_24_1&n=5)
[Sign the Petition](https://www.mahanow.org/pharma-ads-petition?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=pharma_ad_petition_10_20_24_1&n=6)
Here’s what’s at stake:
**Pharma Ads Push Dangerous Drugs**
Remember Vioxx? Despite evidence of heart attack risks, Big Pharma promoted it for years. And with opioids, we were told they were “safe and effective,” yet they’re now taking over [100,000 lives annually.](https://www.mahanow.org/pharma-ads-petition?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=pharma_ad_petition_10_20_24_1&n=7)
**Advertising Costs Make Medicine Unaffordable**
Last year, Big Pharma spent _$37 billion more on ads than on research_. They push their products like car companies, driving up prices and making medication costs unbearable for millions of Americans.
**Our Kids Are Sicker Than Ever**
Today, 60% of American children suffer from chronic health conditions, compared to just 6% in the 1960s. We’re now spending _$4.3 trillion_ each year on healthcare, mainly to treat chronic illnesses.
**Big Pharma Controls the Media**
Pharma ads dominate 70-80% of TV news ad revenue. With networks dependent on this income, they’re pressured to avoid negative coverage of the industry. Big Pharma’s influence over the media is putting our access to truthful information at risk.
We can’t afford to let pharmaceutical ads continue to harm us, drive up healthcare costs, and control the media.
**Take a stand—[ _sign the petition_](https://www.mahanow.org/pharma-ads-petition?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=pharma_ad_petition_10_20_24_1&n=8) now to ban these ads and protect our health and our future.**
[Sign the Petition](https://www.mahanow.org/pharma-ads-petition?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=pharma_ad_petition_10_20_24_1&n=9)
Thank you for taking action.
Team Kennedy

Annie here. I just read a disturbing article in the Huffington Post about what a Trump Administration would do to Medicaid funding — cut it for 73 million Americans, including 50% of America’s CHILDREN.

Medicaid (often confused with Medicare) offers insurance for low-income Americans. It doesn’t just help provide financial security for people in need of basic care, it provides access to medicine and care that is PREVENTIVE. For children, access to the right care at the right time means they can live healthier, fuller, and more productive lives.

So why isn't it more of a political talking point? Medicaid is often framed as a “welfare” program and, well, children can’t vote (yet). Those on Medicare and Social Security can — and they happen to be one of the largest most powerful voting blocks in the nation.

**_Medicaid IS a children’s health insurance program._**

This is EXACTLY why I started Their Future PAC — this is a program that undoubtedly benefits children but... they don’t have a voice in Washington to protect it for them. We HAVE to do it for them and we need leaders who are going to listen to reason to get it done.

**[We only get so many changes to protect our children’s future — this is a REALLY important one. So, please, donate $5 or any amount right now to help our team elect Kids First Candidates on Nov. 5.](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfqtcgBJhuZhcGEdRJ1Hc35jCYEyu_NoywlpdfenfQu6K6qgGcXY3jew3TjhbScBBFXe-lrWHTKei5dwxJF45qxEhrZNdVeYDsyvwcJBBoQfzmNJcPcMMNQymslZWeEt_jkS8QgSOzNrmsY1L4sCuAw3cBwybtAP0Pe-fUWYD60k_XnNDG_yIbnpxuGNm8U5-LXvqFtsjg02jhXuBDBnlwbXxiznDIULy8V3WZXZdwe88hErMeXRbvCLr1u5PTX4MWAs3EpsoPL2NAPWXE_d2-62oEu1_9WTWadlAYYt5lsWeHxuam3f7lUo1dftQ7Ht_4qm59TEXVGUlj5uuz4j1JsZ2MRw64GIjU3I7SfaYI2WtLwkyRiBRhjAGJSHbGm8M8vB7NYL-2kwHbTeMqDGf0LLGf0wDDxcxpVd14eG3kSz_CA/4ay/fi0S4CtaQ1iAtaiuGQoIdg/h1/h001._9UXqXBUkiREL-qn-edscEtehFyDXukRSkQVE8AlrJk)**

_Me and my sisters when we were (much) younger_
Peter —
When I think back to the most difficult experiences in my life, I’m thankful I’ve always had a strong support system to get me to the other side.
Sleeping on the floor in our apartment growing up because we couldn’t afford a bed wasn’t easy.
Working to make ends meet while I was trying to get into a good school wasn’t easy.
Serving in Iraq in one of the hardest hit units of the entire war definitely wasn’t easy.
And running for the U.S. Senate — having Kari Lake attack me day in, day out, while Trump helps her raise millions to smear my name... that hasn’t been easy either.
But as a kid, I had my family.
Getting into school and building a better life, I had a strong community supporting me.
Getting through Iraq, I had my brothers watching my back.
And in this campaign, I have you.
Simply put... I couldn’t do this without your support, Peter When you woke up this morning you probably didn’t think it’d be the day you made a donation to my campaign, but I really need you if we’re going to defeat Kari Lake and defend Arizona and control of the U.S. Senate.

Thank you for opening this email. It's an important one. Yes, we are asking you to make a contribution to the Democratic Party today. Today. It has to be today. But before we share the link to give, let us explain why this request is so important. Here is the truth: In the last few days, a lot of people have asked if it's too late for their contribution to make a difference. The answer to that is no. An emphatic no. It is not too late. In fact, with the days remaining in this race, it is the best time to make a contribution. We still have time to use these resources to turn out infrequent Democratic voters and those who dislike Trump. And in close races across the country, those voters are the difference. Plus, you know instinctively that there are going to be a lot of very close races Republicans will challenge after we win. That'll happen up and down the ballot. Those fights take resources as well. Fellow American,

Barack Obama delivered a message to “the brothers,” AKA Black Men.

He told us, “We have not yet seen the same kinds of energy and turnout in all quarters of our neighborhoods and communities as we saw when I was running,” and to quit making “excuses” and vote for Kamala.

Well, Obama, I have a message for you, “brother.”

[**THE PEOPLE ARE COMING!**](https://links.iterable.com/u/click?_t=ce1ce9e616484205a28a45cfaf96cecf&_m=b2c357b1bb4b442fa187dcdd724b1033&_e=bIcdM4tBoka5GjlyFNMN-nuIif_mrQ9ehxYA3_fSp8zSssUrId3QS0S86wmT6zjG8pL7cD-TPnStOfDD5Bf1ME5D-XemyDaGHm2jO4e0MG3TGx5COMdtb2uhg5lFSkIP5Os4SrXkgptRGaO7YiNNFF-aJxn-bwyhjAGO9M_FLZvkLGLJmt_gudCspZ0E58HOI856uTB-SgqPKAzsyylxiC5ETHCdlcY2mEA5o81a--t-q-Fm6TAMm6FjsaHbTfR91XfSiz4kM_lpsVP9P0u5pE0zoRMVr_ofkW3TewHkFcyqL8tYhk_PYU8opZ5XKBWKzJJ6PYIft3XC0xaKbKdVqw%3D%3D)
You’re not seeing the same kinds of energy and enthusiasm for Kamala Harris as when you ran because our community has WOKEN UP to your lies and deceitfulness.

We are not making “excuses.” We are thinking for ourselves. We see what’s happened to not just the Black Community but to the rest of America in the past four years. In fact, it hasn’t even been just the past four years. In the past 16 years, Democrats have controlled the country for 12 of them.

America only thrived during the four years of the Trump Administration.

Black Men are not blind. We’re able to see that the Radical Left’s policies have been crippling America.

It’s not an “excuse,” it’s a REASON!

That’s why I entered politics after a successful career in professional basketball.

I’m sick and tired of Liberals telling me what to think, how to think, and who to vote for.

Now, I’m running against Amy Klobuchar, an Obama-era Radical Leftist who’s done nothing but help the Left to destroy America.

**I need your help if I’m going to win.

The election is less than 25 days away, and I’m tight on cash.**

_I need to place TV ads and knock on doors in Minnesota so I can reach undecided voters with my unfiltered, uncensored message._

[**Can you donate just $25 before midnight to help me win?**](https://links.iterable.com/u/click?_t=ce1ce9e616484205a28a45cfaf96cecf&_m=b2c357b1bb4b442fa187dcdd724b1033&_e=bIcdM4tBoka5GjlyFNMN-nuIif_mrQ9ehxYA3_fSp8zSssUrId3QS0S86wmT6zjG8pL7cD-TPnStOfDD5Bf1ME5D-XemyDaGHm2jO4e0MG3TGx5COMdtb2uhg5lFSkIP5Os4SrXkgptRGaO7YiNNFF-aJxn-bwyhjAGO9M_FLZvkLGLJmt_gudCspZ0E58HO8kQHRVaBAg0KbXdwFwCGKB1CiYWsLGiMNLUXP30tCP-V2LZX4t_2TYSNeTGGgd7fftYgz3u7NJzKv9fWexen0KKJf2vrVcXfyRrMdLLQXoJ5DgTYFwp-Qxh1YBIE2MrNKirQePFlYtWw3CnpIyuedQ%3D%3D)

The People Are Coming,

Royce White

Hi, friend, it’s Tony Goldwyn. I’m reaching out to you today not as an actor or a former (fictional) president, but as a concerned citizen.
Election Day is just nine days away, and so much is still up in the air. I’m paying particularly close attention to Ohio’s Senate race, where Sherrod Brown is locked in a dead heat against his Trump-backed opponent, Bernie Moreno.

[****](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/95954749/508430998/34470924?refcode=KL_ATA_EM_FR_314_241027_T1_2_b&utm_source=kl_ata_em_fr_314_241027_t1_2_b&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDYvMS84NDIyNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2MTNlMGVjYS1iYTk0LWVmMTEtODhjZS0wMDBkM2E5OGZhNmIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=eCZoO6HR7WGsSMmmELHflJKofRiFOMV_EqFA3nnw4Ws=) Friend, I know you’re getting a lot of emails right now. **But I’d greatly appreciate it if you could take the time to read this one.**

I’m the Chairwoman of the Democratic Congressional Campaign Committee (DCCC) – the committee responsible with our efforts to win the House, a pro-choice woman with a background in STEM like many of the candidates 314 Action is supporting, and a proud mom and grandma who wants to leave our kids a better country and planet than we found it.

That means flipping the House to secure a majority that will protect their rights and their medical autonomy, act on climate, get weapons of war off the streets, slash child poverty, safeguard our democracy, and keep the American Dream within their grasp.

**Democrats are just 4 seats away from flipping the House blue. But we’re facing a record level of spending by the GOP in this final stretch and polling couldn’t be tighter in the handful of races that will decide control of Congress.** Your support today is what will make these races break in our favor.

[**That’s why I’m personally asking if you will donate directly to 6 Democrats running in 6 toss-up Red-to-Blue House races ahead of their deadlines tonight. If Christina Bohannan (IA-1), Dr. Amish Shah (AZ-1), Janelle Bynum (OR-5), George Whitesides (CA-27), John Mannion (NY-22), and Tony Vargas (NE-2) win we have the numbers to flip the House blue.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/95954750/508430999/34470924?refcode=KL_ATA_EM_FR_314_241027_T1_2_b&utm_source=kl_ata_em_fr_314_241027_t1_2_b&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDYvMS84NDIyNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2MTNlMGVjYS1iYTk0LWVmMTEtODhjZS0wMDBkM2E5OGZhNmIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=eCZoO6HR7WGsSMmmELHflJKofRiFOMV_EqFA3nnw4Ws=) [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/95954751/508431000/34470924?refcode=KL_ATA_EM_FR_314_241027_T1_2_b&utm_source=kl_ata_em_fr_314_241027_t1_2_b&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDYvMS84NDIyNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2MTNlMGVjYS1iYTk0LWVmMTEtODhjZS0wMDBkM2E5OGZhNmIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=eCZoO6HR7WGsSMmmELHflJKofRiFOMV_EqFA3nnw4Ws=) **Christina Bohannan (IA-1)** – Christina is an environmental engineer and law professor who defeated a 20-year incumbent to secure a seat in the Iowa State Legislature.

In 2020, Republicans flipped this seat from blue to red by the slimmest margin of any House race in nearly an entire century – a margin of just 6 votes (0.01% of the vote). And polling confirms it could be just as competitive this November.

Normington, Petts & Associates Poll: Bohannan 47% – Miller-Meeks 47% [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/95954752/508431001/34470924?refcode=KL_ATA_EM_FR_314_241027_T1_2_b&utm_source=kl_ata_em_fr_314_241027_t1_2_b&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDYvMS84NDIyNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2MTNlMGVjYS1iYTk0LWVmMTEtODhjZS0wMDBkM2E5OGZhNmIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=eCZoO6HR7WGsSMmmELHflJKofRiFOMV_EqFA3nnw4Ws=) **Dr. Amish Shah (AZ-1)** – Amish is an Emergency Room physician at the Mayo Clinic of Arizona and State Representative who had the most bills signed into law of any Arizona Democrat of the past decade.

In 2022, Republicans barely defended this seat by a margin of just 3,195 votes (which was less than 1% of the vote). It could be even closer this time around. In 2020, Joe Biden won this district by 1.5%.

Impact Research Poll: Shah 48% – Schweikert 48% [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/95954753/508431002/34470924?refcode=KL_ATA_EM_FR_314_241027_T1_2_b&utm_source=kl_ata_em_fr_314_241027_t1_2_b&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDYvMS84NDIyNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2MTNlMGVjYS1iYTk0LWVmMTEtODhjZS0wMDBkM2E5OGZhNmIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=eCZoO6HR7WGsSMmmELHflJKofRiFOMV_EqFA3nnw4Ws=) **Janelle Bynum (OR-5)** – Janelle is an electrical engineer, small business owner, and former State Representative who has defeated Republican Lori Chavez-DeRemer (who she is now running against) not once but twice at the state level.

In 2022, Republicans flipped this seat from blue to red by a razor-thin margin of just 2.1% of the vote. In 2020, Joe Biden won this district by 8.8% of the vote – one of the largest margins of any House seat actively held by a Republican.

Noble Predictive Insights Poll: Bynum 43% – Chavez-DeRemer 42% [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/95954754/508431003/34470924?refcode=KL_ATA_EM_FR_314_241027_T1_2_b&utm_source=kl_ata_em_fr_314_241027_t1_2_b&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDYvMS84NDIyNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2MTNlMGVjYS1iYTk0LWVmMTEtODhjZS0wMDBkM2E5OGZhNmIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=eCZoO6HR7WGsSMmmELHflJKofRiFOMV_EqFA3nnw4Ws=) **George Whitesides (CA-27)** – George is an aerospace expert who served as the Chief of Staff for NASA under President Barack Obama, served as CEO of the spaceflight company Virgin Galactic, and co-founded a group to address wildfire disasters.

In 2020, Republicans flipped this seat from blue to red by a razor-thin margin – just 333 votes (a margin of 0.1% of the vote). In 2020, Joe Biden won this district by a massive margin of 12.4% of the vote – more than almost any other House district currently represented by a Republican.

University of Southern California Poll: Whitesides 48% – Garcia 46% [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/95954755/508431004/34470924?refcode=KL_ATA_EM_FR_314_241027_T1_2_b&utm_source=kl_ata_em_fr_314_241027_t1_2_b&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDYvMS84NDIyNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2MTNlMGVjYS1iYTk0LWVmMTEtODhjZS0wMDBkM2E5OGZhNmIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=eCZoO6HR7WGsSMmmELHflJKofRiFOMV_EqFA3nnw4Ws=) **John Mannion (NY-22)** – John is a former science teacher who won a highly competitive State Senate seat on Republican turf by just 10 votes to win a seat in the New York State Legislature.

In 2022, Republicans barely defended this House seat by a razor-thin margin of just 2,631 votes (which is less than 1% of the vote!).

In 2020, Joe Biden won this district by a margin of 7.4% of the vote – which is part of the reason the National Journal labeled this as **the best red-to-blue pickup opportunity** in the United States! [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/95954756/508431005/34470924?refcode=KL_ATA_EM_FR_314_241027_T1_2_b&utm_source=kl_ata_em_fr_314_241027_t1_2_b&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDYvMS84NDIyNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2MTNlMGVjYS1iYTk0LWVmMTEtODhjZS0wMDBkM2E5OGZhNmIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=eCZoO6HR7WGsSMmmELHflJKofRiFOMV_EqFA3nnw4Ws=) **Tony Vargas (NE-2)** – Tony is a former science teacher and school board member who currently serves in the Nebraska State Senate.

In 2022, Tony fell just 5,856 votes (a margin of just 2.6% of the vote) of flipping this seat from red to blue. In 2020, Joe Biden won this district by a margin of 6.4% of the vote and it's only grown more Democratic since.
