Hi Peter,

We wanted to provide an update to you now that we are halfway through our 72-hour Get Out The Vote (GOTV) fundraising campaign. We need to reach our goal of $10,000! So far we have raised $3,986 towards our goal, so we are running way behind. It is critical that we reach our fundraising goal so that we can have a robust GOTV effort and make every final effort to help our endorsed candidates.

Every donation, no matter the amount, will help us make the last days of the election as productive and meaningful as possible in spreading our pro-gun reform message and helping save our democracy from Donald Trump. We have to keep reaching out to voters and help ensure they get out and vote. This election is critical to not only the gun reform movement but also for LGBTQ quality. Lives are at stake

Will you donate $5, $10, $25 or more to help us achieve our fundraising goal of $10,000 so we can reach more voters to ensure victory on Election Day? A generous donor passionate about gun reform will DOUBLE your donation! 2 Times the Impact! [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/pf202472hour?refcode=2000&amount=25&recurring=yes]

I know we send a lot of fundraising emails, but the truth is, we couldn’t do any of our important work without your financial support. Your donations fuel our work and show the NRA and Republicans that the gun violence prevention movement is a force to be reckoned with.

People like you help us fight back against the NRA’s massive spending in the elections process. In the 2016 election alone, the NRA spent nearly $55 million dollars to influence federal elections, spending most of it on Trump’s campaign. In 2020 they spent nearly $30 million. We are a grassroots organization of dedicated supporters who are working to fight back as much as we can and we have succeeded in helping many of our endorsed candidates in previous years win their elections. The work we do matters.

We have less than 24 hours before we have to reach our fundraising deadline -- Donate $5 or more today to help us elect officials who will keep our communities safe! Your donation will be MATCHED! [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/pf202472hour?refcode=2000&amount=25&recurring=yes]

Thank you for everything,

clean_body: [] Hi Peter, We wanted to provide an update to you now that we are halfway through our 72-hour Get Out The Vote (GOTV) fundraising campaign. We need to reach our goal of $10,000! So far we have raised $3,986 towards our goal, so we are running way behind. It is critical that we reach our fundraising goal so that we can have a robust GOTV effort and make every final effort to help our endorsed candidates. Every donation, no matter the amount, will help us make the last days of the election as productive and meaningful as possible in spreading our pro-gun reform message and helping save our democracy from Donald Trump. We have to keep reaching out to voters and help ensure they get out and vote. This election is critical to not only the gun reform movement but also for LGBTQ quality. Lives are at stake Will you donate $5, $10, $25 or more to help us achieve our fundraising goal of $10,000 so we can reach more voters to ensure victory on Election Day? A generous donor passionate about gun reform will DOUBLE your donation! 2 Times the Impact! [] I know we send a lot of fundraising emails, but the truth is, we couldn’t do any of our important work without your financial support. Your donations fuel our work and show the NRA and Republicans that the gun violence prevention movement is a force to be reckoned with. People like you help us fight back against the NRA’s massive spending in the elections process. In the 2016 election alone, the NRA spent nearly $55 million dollars to influence federal elections, spending most of it on Trump’s campaign. In 2020 they spent nearly $30 million. We are a grassroots organization of dedicated supporters who are working to fight back as much as we can and we have succeeded in helping many of our endorsed candidates in previous years win their elections. The work we do matters. We have less than 24 hours before we have to reach our fundraising deadline -- Donate $5 or more today to help us elect officials who will keep our communities safe! Your donation will be MATCHED! [] Thank you for everything, Pride Fund to End Gun Violence [] [] Paid for by the Pride Fund to End Gun Violence PAC. Copyright 2024 Pride Fund to End Gun Violence P.O.
